holidays (Public holidays by country+year (nager.date; e.g. '中国 2026', 'US 2025')); worldclock (Current time in a city/timezone — computed locally, zero network (e.g. '东京', 'America/New_York')); openmeteo (Current weather by city name (open-meteo, keyless; tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

96:     checks: startupHealth.checks.map((c) => ({ name: c.name, ok: !!c.ok, detail: c.detail })),
97:     warnings: startupHealth.warnings,

const catTrip = require('./routes/cat-trip'); // WorkBuddy 成长活动端点（/v1/workbuddy/growth）
// 管理面板的登录密钥存于 localStorage（web/src/stores/useAuth.ts），同源任意脚本可读，

// style 放开 'unsafe-inline' 是 Tailwind 构建产物含内联样式所需；script 不放开任何 unsafe-*。
// 转发面与运维快照不是 HTML 文档，加 CSP 只会干扰客户端处理响应体
* 启动期健康快照。由 runStartupChecks() 在 listen 之前填充，
* /health 读它返回真实状态，而不是硬编码 'ok'。
* /health：真实健康检查（此前 status 是硬编码 'ok' 字符串，
* 只反映「进程还在」，DB 坏了也返回 ok，服务管理器无法据此重启）。

* 免鉴权，因此 checks 只返回布尔与简短文案，不泄露路径或密钥材料。

281:   // 只保留已知列，未知键直接忽略（此前全列重写会顺带写入未知键的 undefined）
282:   const keys = Object.keys(patch).filter((k) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(PATCH_COLUMNS, k));
283:   if (keys.length === 0) {
284:     // 没有任何可写列：仍要确认账号存在，保持不存在返回 null 的契约
285:     const cur = get(id);
286:     return cur ? safeTok(cur) : null;
287:   }
288: 
289:   const RETRY_MAX = 3;
290:   for (let attempt = 0; attempt < RETRY_MAX; attempt += 1) {
291:     const row = rawRow(id);
292:     if (!row) return null;
293: 
294:     const setParts = [];
295:     const args = [];
296:     for (const k of keys) {
297:       const spec = PATCH_COLUMNS[k];
298:       setParts.push(`${spec.col} = ?`);
299:       // 取值函数收到「当前行 + 本键新值」的合并视图，
300:       // 因为部分列（如 source 的默认值、modelCooldowns 的空对象判定）依赖完整语义
301:       args.push(spec.val({ ...rowToDecrypted(row, false), [k]: patch[k] }));
302:     }
303:     setParts.push('version = version + 1');
304: 
305:     const info = db()
306:       .prepare(`UPDATE accounts SET ${setParts.join(', ')} WHERE id = ? AND version = ?`)
307:       .run(...args, id, Number(row.version) || 0);
308: 
309:     if (info.changes > 0) {
310:       // 与旧实现保持同一返回契约：脱敏后的账号（不含 token/refreshToken/apiKey/version）。
311:       // 注意不能直接 return get(id) —— get() 按设计返回解密后的密文字段。
312:       return safeTok(get(id));
313:     }
314:     // changes === 0：期间被其它写入方改过（version 变了），重读重试。
315:     // 账号被删也会落到这里（下一轮 rawRow 返回 null，返回 null）。
316:   }
317:   const e = new Error(`账号 ${id} 并发写入冲突：连续 ${RETRY_MAX} 次 version 不匹配`);
318:   e.code = WRITE_CONFLICT;
319:   throw e;
320: }
321: 
322: /** 读原始行（含 version 与密文列），仅供 update 做 CAS 用。 */
323: function rawRow(id) {
324:   return db().prepare('SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE id = ?').get(id) || null;
325: }
326: 
327: function remove(id) {
328:   const info = db().prepare('DELETE FROM accounts WHERE id = ?').run(id);
329:   // 同步清理积分快照，避免删号后留下孤儿 credit_history 记录
330:   if (info.changes > 0) {
331:     db().prepare('DELETE FROM credit_history WHERE account_id = ?').run(id);
332:   }
333:   return info.changes > 0;
334: }

try { return JSON.stringify(v); } catch { return String(v); }

// version 是 update() 的乐观锁内部字段，不属于账号业务数据，不外泄。

* update() 只写 patch 里真正出现的列（不再全列重写），这是修复丢失更新的前提：
* 全列重写时，另一写入方刚写入的字段会被当前这份陈旧快照覆盖回去。
* 列名必须显式声明：token→token_enc、group→group_name 这类不是简单驼峰转换。

1: 'use strict';
2: /**
3:  * credentials/credits.js — 权益包（积分）的纯计算。
4:  *
5:  * 从 upstream/balance.js 抽出：这些函数不涉及任何 IO，却被 credentials/pool.js
6:  * 用于调度排序（FEFO 临期优先）。留在 upstream 里会让 credentials 反向依赖
7:  * upstream——底层模块依赖上层模块，方向倒置。
8:  *
9:  * 放在 credentials 下是因为它描述账号权益包这一领域概念，
10:  * 与 credit-history.js 同域；upstream/balance.js 作为使用方从这里取。
11:  */
12: 
13: /** 积分四舍五入到 2 位小数，消除浮点累加噪声。 */
14: function roundCredits(n) {
15:   if (n == null || !Number.isFinite(n)) return n;
16:   return Math.round(n * 100) / 100;
17: }
18: 
19: /** 自然日差：expire 落在今天为 0，明天为 1，以此类推。 */
20: function naturalDayDiff(expireSec, nowMs) {
21:   if (typeof expireSec !== 'number' || expireSec <= 0) return null;
22:   const startOfDay = (ms) => {
23:     const d = new Date(ms);
24:     d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
25:     return d.getTime();
26:   };
27:   const expireMs = expireSec * 1000;
28:   return Math.round((startOfDay(expireMs) - startOfDay(nowMs)) / 86400000);
29: }
30: 
31: /**
32:  * 汇总 3 天内 / 7 天内到期且未用完的积分。
33:  *
34:  * @param {Array<{expireTime?:number, remaining?:number|null, unlimited?:boolean}>} packs
35:  * @param {number} [nowMs]
36:  * @returns {{d3:number, d7:number}}
37:  */
38: function summarizeExpiry(packs, nowMs) {
39:   const now = nowMs == null ? Date.now() : nowMs;
40:   const empty = { d3: 0, d7: 0 };
41:   if (!Array.isArray(packs) || !packs.length) return empty;
42:   let d3 = 0;
43:   let d7 = 0;
44:   for (const p of packs) {
45:     const dayDiff = naturalDayDiff(p && p.expireTime, now);
46:     if (dayDiff == null || dayDiff < 0) continue;
47:     // unlimited（remaining=null）不计入临期金额
48:     if (p.remaining == null) continue;
49:     const rem = roundCredits(p.remaining);
50:     if (dayDiff <= 3) d3 += rem;
51:     if (dayDiff <= 7) d7 += rem;
52:   }
53:   return { d3: roundCredits(d3), d7: roundCredits(d7) };
54: }
55: 
56: /**
57:  * 汇总最早到期信息，供账号池 FEFO（先到期先用）排序。
58:  *
59:  * 背景：此前 least_balance 只按 d3/d7 金额分档排序，无法区分
60:  * 3 天后到期的 68 分与 7 天后到期的 68 分，也分不出
61:  * 同档内到期时间更早的账号，临期积分会因余额策略被白白浪费。
62:  * FEFO 直接以最近一个未用尽权益包的到期时刻为准，先到期先消耗。
63:  *
64:  * 判定口径：
65:  * - 只统计 remaining > 0 且未过期的包（已用尽、unlimited、无到期时间的都跳过）。
66:  * - 多个包取 expireTime 最小者作为 soonest。
67:  * - 仅有 unlimited 包时视为不会过期，返回 never=true。
68:  *
69:  * @param {Array<{expireTime?:number, remaining?:number|null, unlimited?:boolean}>} packs
70:  * @param {number} [nowMs]
71:  * @returns {{soonest:number|null, soonestMs:number|null, soonestAmount:number,
72:  *            soonestDays:number|null, expiringAmount:number, never:boolean,
73:  *            hasExpiry:boolean}}
74:  */
75: function summarizeFefo(packs, nowMs) {
76:   const now = nowMs == null ? Date.now() : nowMs;
77:   const out = {
78:     soonest: null, soonestMs: null, soonestAmount: 0,
79:     soonestDays: null, expiringAmount: 0, never: false, hasExpiry: false,
80:   };
81:   if (!Array.isArray(packs) || !packs.length) return out;
82: 
83:   let sawUnlimited = false;
84:   for (const p of packs) {
85:     if (!p || typeof p !== 'object') continue;
86:     // unlimited 包永不过期：仅在没有任何可计量包时作为标记
87:     if (p.remaining == null || p.unlimited === true) { sawUnlimited = true; continue; }
88:     const rem = roundCredits(p.remaining);
89:     if (!(rem > 0)) continue; // 已用尽
90:     const expireSec = p.expireTime;
91:     // 无到期时间 = 长期有效，不参与 FEFO 抢占
92:     if (typeof expireSec !== 'number' || expireSec <= 0) continue;
93:     const ms = expireSec * 1000;
94:     if (ms <= now) continue; // 已过期
95:     out.expiringAmount = roundCredits(out.expiringAmount + rem);
96:     if (out.soonestMs === null || ms < out.soonestMs) {
97:       out.soonestMs = ms;
98:       out.soonest = expireSec;
99:       out.soonestAmount = rem;
100:     }
101:   }
102:   out.hasExpiry = out.soonestMs !== null;
103:   if (!out.hasExpiry) out.never = sawUnlimited;
104:   out.soonestDays = out.soonestMs === null
105:     ? null
106:     : Math.round(((out.soonestMs - now) / 86400000) * 100) / 100;
107:   return out;
108: }
109: 
110: module.exports = { roundCredits, naturalDayDiff, summarizeExpiry, summarizeFefo };

49: /** 领取结果语义（供调用方分流，不用字符串判断）。 */
50: const CLAIM_RESULT = Object.freeze({
51:   CLAIMED: 'claimed',
52:   ALREADY: 'already',
53:   FAILED: 'failed',
54:   RISK: 'risk',
55: });
56: 
57: /** 是否为 ZCode 账号（显式比较，不做默认推断）。 */
58: function isZcode(acct) {
59:   return !!acct && variant.isEdition(acct.edition, variant.ZCODE);
60: }
61: 
62: /** 账号是否具备走 billing 面的凭据。 */
63: function billingBlockReason(acct, { action = '操作' } = {}) {
64:   if (!isZcode(acct)) return `非 ZCode 账号，已跳过${action}`;
65:   if (!acct.enabled) return `账号已停用，已跳过${action}`;
66:   if (!String(acct.token || '').trim()) return `账号缺少 JWT 凭据，已跳过${action}`;
67:   return null;
68: }
69: 
70: /** 码 → 文案。 */
71: function failText(code, msg) {
72:   const base = CLAIM_FAIL_TEXT[code] || '领取失败';
73:   const server = String(msg || '').trim();
74:   return server ? `${base}（${server}）` : base;
75: }
76: 
77: /** 解析 preview 的套餐项（只保留 token 计量口径的授权项）。 */
78: function parsePlan(raw) {
79:   if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return null;
80:   const planId = String(raw.plan_id || raw.planId || '').trim();
81:   if (!planId) return null;
82:   const grants = [];
83:   for (const ent of Array.isArray(raw.entitlements) ? raw.entitlements : []) {
84:     if (!ent || typeof ent !== 'object') continue;
85:     if (ent.meter !== 'model_usage' || ent.unit_type !== 'token') continue;
86:     const name = String(ent.show_name || ent.showName || '').trim();
87:     if (!name) continue;
88:     grants.push({
89:       name,
90:       units: Number(ent.grant_units || ent.grantUnits || 0) || 0,
91:       period: String(ent.period || 'one_time'),
92:       capabilities: Array.isArray(ent.capabilities) ? ent.capabilities : [],
93:     });
94:   }
95:   return {
96:     planId,
97:     name: String(raw.name || '').trim(),
98:     description: String(raw.description || '').trim(),
99:     priority: Number(raw.priority) || 0,
100:     grants,
101:   };
102: }
103: 
104: /**
105:  * 上报激活事件（官方客户端启动/日活）。
106:  * 失败只记录，不阻断——它只是疑似资格信号，且日活键在上游按
107:  * device_mid + 日期去重，重试无意义。
108:  * @returns {Promise<{ok:string[], failed:string[]}>}
109:  */
110: async function reportActivation(acct) {
111:   const fp = fingerprint.profileFor(acct, (fresh) => {
112:     try { store.update(acct.id, { fingerprint: fresh }); } catch { /* 账号库写入失败不阻断 */ }
113:   });
114:   const userId = jwtUserId(acct.token);
115:   const result = { ok: [], failed: [] };
116:   if (!userId) {
117:     result.failed.push('JWT 无 user_id，跳过激活上报');
118:     return result;
119:   }
120:   for (const element of V.activationElements) {
121:     const body = buildActivationEvent(element, fp, userId);
122:     try {
123:       // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
124:       const envelope = await request({
125:         method: 'POST',
126:         path: V.paths.eventReport,
127:         headers: identity.eventHeaders(),
128:         body,
129:         timeoutMs: 10000,
130:       });
131:       if (envelope && Number(envelope.code) === 0) result.ok.push(element);
132:       else result.failed.push(`${element}: code=${envelope && envelope.code}`);
133:     } catch (e) {
134:       result.failed.push(`${element}: ${e.message}`);
135:     }
136:   }
137:   return result;
138: }
139: 
140: /** 官方 sendReport 的 16 字段事件体（字段集固定，不可增删）。 */
141: function buildActivationEvent(element, fp, userId) {
142:   const crypto = require('crypto');
143:   return {
144:     event_id: crypto.randomUUID(),
145:     client_timezone: fp.timezone,
146:     client_language: fp.language,
147:     element_name: element,
148:     event_region: 'app',
149:     event_type: 'view',
150:     event_text: '',
151:     event_extra_detail: {},
152:     user_id: userId,
153:     screen_resolution: fp.screen,
154:     app_version: identity.appVersion(),
155:     device_os_category: fingerprint.osCategory(fp),
156:     device_os_version: fp.osVersion,
157:     device_mid: fp.deviceMid,
158:     mac_id: '',
159:     marketing_params: '{}',
160:   };
161: }
162: 
163: /** 从 JWT 解出 user_id（缺失时回退 sub）；不校验签名（只读取自己存的凭据）。 */
164: function jwtUserId(token) {
165:   const t = String(token || '').trim();
166:   if (!t) return null;
167:   const seg = t.split('.')[1];
168:   if (!seg) return null;
169:   try {
170:     const payload = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(seg, 'base64url').toString('utf-8'));
171:     const uid = payload.user_id || payload.sub;
172:     return uid != null && String(uid).trim() ? String(uid).trim() : null;
173:   } catch {
174:     return null;
175:   }
176: }
177: 
178: /**
179:  * 拉取当前账号可领取的套餐（按优先级降序）。
180:  * @returns {Promise<Array<object>>}
181:  */
182: async function previewPlans(acct) {
183:   const blocked = billingBlockReason(acct, { action: '查询' });
184:   if (blocked) throw new ZCodeApiError(blocked, { code: null });
185:   const envelope = await request({
186:     method: 'GET',
187:     path: V.paths.billingPreview,
188:     headers: buildBillingHeaders(acct),
189:     query: { app_version: identity.appVersion() },
190:   });
191:   const data = unwrap(envelope, { method: 'GET', path: V.paths.billingPreview });
192:   const raw = Array.isArray(data && data.plans) ? data.plans : [];
193:   return raw.map(parsePlan).filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => (b.priority - a.priority) || a.planId.localeCompare(b.planId));
194: }
195: 
196: /** billing 面身份头（含账号指纹与 token）。 */
197: function buildBillingHeaders(acct) {
198:   const fp = fingerprint.profileFor(acct, (fresh) => {
199:     try { store.update(acct.id, { fingerprint: fresh }); } catch { /* 账号库写入失败不阻断 */ }
200:   });
201:   return identity.identityHeaders(fp, { token: acct.token });
202: }
203: 
204: /**
205:  * 查询账号额度（billing/balance）。
206:  * 返回 { plans, balances, serverTime }。
207:  */
208: async function fetchBalance(acct) {
209:   const blocked = billingBlockReason(acct, { action: '查询额度' });
210:   if (blocked) throw new ZCodeApiError(blocked, { code: null });
211:   const envelope = await request({
212:     method: 'GET',
213:     path: V.paths.billingBalance,
214:     headers: buildBillingHeaders(acct),
215:     query: { app_version: identity.appVersion() },
216:   });
217:   const data = unwrap(envelope, { method: 'GET', path: V.paths.billingBalance }) || {};
218:   return {
219:     plans: Array.isArray(data.plans) ? data.plans : [],
220:     balances: Array.isArray(data.balances) ? data.balances : [],
221:     serverTime: data.server_time,
222:   };
223: }
224: 
225: /**
226:  * 领取指定套餐（或自动选优先级最高的）。
227:  *
228:  * 验证码策略：3007 换码重试一次（参数一次性且可能被风控拒绝）。
229:  * 幂等：1003「已领取过」按 already 返回，不视为失败。
230:  *
231:  * @param {object} acct
232:  * @param {string} [planId]
233:  * @param {{maxCaptchaRetries?:number}} [opts]
234:  * @returns {Promise<{result:string, planId:string, planName:string, grants:Array, message:string, code:number|null}>}
235:  */
236: async function claimPlan(acct, planId, opts = {}) {
237:   const blocked = billingBlockReason(acct, { action: '领取' });
238:   if (blocked) throw new ZCodeApiError(blocked, { code: null });
239: 
240:   let target = String(planId || '').trim();
241:   let planName = '';
242:   let grants = [];
243:   if (!target) {
244:     const plans = await previewPlans(acct);
245:     if (!plans.length) {
246:       return {
247:         result: CLAIM_RESULT.FAILED, planId: '', planName: '', grants: [],
248:         message: '当前没有可领取的套餐', code: null,
249:       };
250:     }
251:     target = plans[0].planId;
252:     planName = plans[0].name || plans[0].planId;
253:     grants = plans[0].grants;
254:   }
255: 
256:   const maxRetries = Math.max(1, Number(opts.maxCaptchaRetries || 2));
257:   let lastCode = null;
258:   let lastMsg = '';
259: 
260:   for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
261:     // 验证码每次现解：certifyId 一次性，复用必被拒（F008 重复提交检测）
262:     let verify;
263:     try {
264:       // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
265:       verify = await captcha.getVerifyParam();
266:     } catch (e) {
267:       if (e instanceof captcha.CaptchaUnavailableError) {
268:         return {
269:           result: CLAIM_RESULT.FAILED, planId: target, planName, grants,
270:           message: `验证码不可用：${e.message}`, code: null,
271:         };
272:       }
273:       return {
274:         result: CLAIM_RESULT.FAILED, planId: target, planName, grants,
275:         message: e.message, code: null,
276:       };
277:     }
278: 
279:     const headers = {
280:       ...buildBillingHeaders(acct),
281:       ...captcha.claimHeaders(verify.param, verify.region),
282:     };
283: 
284:     let envelope;
285:     try {
286:       // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
287:       envelope = await request({
288:         method: 'POST',
289:         path: V.paths.billingClaim,
290:         headers,
291:         body: { plan_id: target },
292:       });
293:     } catch (e) {
294:       if (e instanceof ZCodeApiError) {
295:         lastCode = e.code;
296:         lastMsg = e.message;
297:       } else {
298:         return {
299:           result: CLAIM_RESULT.FAILED, planId: target, planName, grants,
300:           message: e.message, code: null,
301:         };
302:       }
303:       break;
304:     }
305: 
306:     const code = Number(envelope && envelope.code);
307:     const msg = String((envelope && (envelope.msg || envelope.message)) || '').trim();
308: 
309:     if (code === 0) {
310:       const plan = (envelope.data && envelope.data.plan) || {};
311:       return {
312:         result: CLAIM_RESULT.CLAIMED,
313:         planId: String(plan.plan_id || target),
314:         planName: planName || String(plan.name || target),
315:         grants,
316:         message: msg || '领取成功',
317:         code: 0,
318:         plan,
319:       };
320:     }
321:     if (code === ERR.alreadyClaimed) {
322:       return {
323:         result: CLAIM_RESULT.ALREADY, planId: target, planName, grants,
324:         message: failText(code, msg), code,
325:       };
326:     }
327:     if (code === ERR.riskControl) {
328:       return {
329:         result: CLAIM_RESULT.RISK, planId: target, planName, grants,
330:         message: failText(code, msg), code,
331:       };
332:     }
333:     lastCode = code;
334:     lastMsg = msg;
335:     if (code === ERR.captchaFailed && attempt < maxRetries) {
336:       console.warn(`[zcode-rewards] 账号 ${acct.label || acct.id} 验证码被拒，换码重试`);
337:       continue;
338:     }
339:     break;
340:   }
341: 
342:   return {
343:     result: CLAIM_RESULT.FAILED, planId: target, planName, grants,
344:     message: failText(lastCode, lastMsg), code: lastCode,
345:   };
346: }
347: 
348: /**
349:  * 探测（不领取）：上报激活 → preview。
350:  * 这是定时任务的主路径，也是「只查不领」模式的实现。
351:  *
352:  * @param {object} acct
353:  * @param {{activation?:boolean}} [opts]
354:  * @returns {Promise<{accountId:string, label:string, plans:Array, activation:object|null, error:string|null}>}
355:  */
356: async function probe(acct, opts = {}) {
357:   const out = {
358:     accountId: acct.id,
359:     label: acct.label || acct.id,
360:     plans: [],
361:     activation: null,
362:     error: null,
363:   };
364:   if (opts.activation !== false) {
365:     try {
366:       out.activation = await reportActivation(acct);
367:     } catch (e) {
368:       out.activation = { ok: [], failed: [e.message] };
369:     }
370:   }
371:   try {
372:     out.plans = await previewPlans(acct);
373:   } catch (e) {
374:     out.error = e.message;
375:   }
376:   return out;
377: }
378: 
379: /**
380:  * 对单个账号执行「探测 + 领取全部可领套餐」。
381:  * @param {object} acct
382:  * @param {{claim?:boolean}} [opts] claim=false 时只探测
383:  */
384: async function runForAccount(acct, opts = {}) {
385:   const probed = await probe(acct, opts);
386:   const out = { ...probed, claimed: [], already: [], failed: [], risk: null };
387:   if (opts.claim === false || probed.error || !probed.plans.length) return out;
388: 
389:   for (const plan of probed.plans) {
390:     // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
391:     const r = await claimPlan(acct, plan.planId);
392:     if (r.result === CLAIM_RESULT.CLAIMED) out.claimed.push(r);
393:     else if (r.result === CLAIM_RESULT.ALREADY) out.already.push(r);
394:     else if (r.result === CLAIM_RESULT.RISK) { out.risk = r; break; }
395:     else out.failed.push(r);
396:     // 账号内多套餐间保底间隔：避免同刻连击上游
397:     // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
398:     await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 1500));
399:   }
400:   return out;
401: }
402: 
403: module.exports = {
404:   CLAIM_RESULT,
405:   CLAIM_FAIL_TEXT,
406:   isZcode,
407:   billingBlockReason,
408:   parsePlan,
409:   jwtUserId,
410:   buildActivationEvent,
411:   reportActivation,
412:   previewPlans,
413:   fetchBalance,
414:   claimPlan,
415:   probe,
416:   runForAccount,
417: };

1: 'use strict';
2: /**
3:  * zcode/local.js — 从本机 ZCode 桌面客户端凭据导入账号。
4:  *
5:  * 客户端把凭据存在 ~/.zcode/v2/credentials.json，字段为 AES-256-GCM 密文
6:  * （"enc:v1:<iv>.<tag>.<ciphertext>"，base64url 三段）。加密实现取自客户端
7:  * asar（app/host/index.js 的 createCredentialCipherProvider）：
8:  *
9:  *   key   = sha256(secret)
10:  *   secret= env.ZCODE_CREDENTIAL_SECRET
11:  *         || `zcode-credential-fallback:${os.platform()}:${os.homedir()}:${os.userInfo().username}`
12:  *
13:  * 平台语义：os.platform() → 'win32'；homedir 用绝对路径（C:\Users\<user>）。
14:  * 本模块只读取本机上自己账号的凭据，不接受远程导入。
15:  */
16: const fs = require('fs');
17: const os = require('os');
18: const path = require('path');
19: const crypto = require('crypto');
20: 
21: const PREFIX = 'enc:v1:';
22: 
23: function credentialsPath() {
24:   const p = String(process.env.ZCODE_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS || '').trim();
25:   if (p) return p;
26:   return path.join(os.homedir(), '.zcode', 'v2', 'credentials.json');
27: }
28: 
29: function telemetryPath() {
30:   const p = String(process.env.ZCODE_CLIENT_TELEMETRY || '').trim();
31:   if (p) return p;
32:   return path.join(os.homedir(), '.zcode', 'v2', 'telemetry-state.json');
33: }
34: 
35: /** 与客户端 t7() 同源的密钥派生。 */
36: function deriveSecret() {
37:   const env = String(process.env.ZCODE_CREDENTIAL_SECRET || '').trim();
38:   if (env) return env;
39:   const platform = os.platform(); // 'win32' / 'darwin' / 'linux'
40:   const home = os.homedir();
41:   let username = '';
42:   try { username = os.userInfo().username; } catch { username = ''; }
43:   return `zcode-credential-fallback:${platform}:${home}:${username}`;
44: }
45: 
46: function b64urlToBuf(s) {
47:   return Buffer.from(s, 'base64url');
48: }
49: 
50: /** 解密单个字段；非密文原样返回。 */
51: function decryptField(val, key) {
52:   if (typeof val !== 'string' || !val.startsWith(PREFIX)) return val;
53:   const [ivB, tagB, ctB] = val.slice(PREFIX.length).split('.');
54:   if (!ivB || !tagB || !ctB) throw new Error('密文格式非法（应为 iv.tag.ct 三段）');
55:   const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, b64urlToBuf(ivB));
56:   decipher.setAuthTag(b64urlToBuf(tagB));
57:   return Buffer.concat([decipher.update(b64urlToBuf(ctB)), decipher.final()]).toString('utf-8');
58: }
59: 
60: /** 本机客户端是否安装（凭据文件存在）。 */
61: function isClientInstalled() {
62:   return fs.existsSync(credentialsPath());
63: }
64: 
65: /**
66:  * 读取并解密本机客户端凭据。
67:  * @returns {object} { 'zcodejwttoken': '...', 'oauth:bigmodel:access_token': '...', ... }
68:  */
69: function readLocalCredentials() {
70:   const file = credentialsPath();
71:   if (!fs.existsSync(file)) {
72:     throw new Error(`未找到 ZCode 客户端凭据文件：${file}（请确认已安装并登录过客户端）`);
73:   }
74:   const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf-8'));
75:   const key = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(deriveSecret()).digest();
76:   const out = {};
77:   for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(raw)) {
78:     try { out[k] = decryptField(v, key); } catch (e) {
79:       // 密钥不匹配（用户改过用户名/家目录）时逐字段报错，便于定位
80:       throw new Error(`字段 ${k} 解密失败：${e.message}（若客户端重装过，请检查 ZCODE_CREDENTIAL_SECRET）`);
81:     }
82:   }
83:   return out;
84: }
85: 
86: /** 读 deviceMid（客户端设备标识；导入时作为指纹 device_mid 的初始值）。 */
87: function readDeviceMid() {
88:   try {
89:     const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(telemetryPath(), 'utf-8'));
90:     return raw && typeof raw.deviceMid === 'string' ? raw.deviceMid : null;
91:   } catch {
92:     return null;
93:   }
94: }
95: 
96: /**
97:  * 从本机客户端凭据构造 store 账号记录（未入库）。
98:  * mode 固定 'jwt'（billing 面只认 zcodejwttoken）；api_key 通道本机客户端不产生。
99:  *
100:  * 设备档案用 forHost 而非随机 SKU：本机账号就是这台机器上的真实客户端账号，
101:  * 沿用真实 deviceMid 与宿主平台形态，比随机生成伦敦的 Mac 更少设备维度风险
102:  * （客户端自己上报的激活/日活事件用的就是这个 deviceMid）。
103:  */
104: function buildAccountFromLocal() {
105:   const creds = readLocalCredentials();
106:   const jwt = String(creds.zcodejwttoken || '').trim();
107:   if (!jwt) throw new Error('本机凭据中无 zcodejwttoken（客户端可能未完成登录）');
108:   const userId = jwtUserId(jwt);
109:   const deviceMid = readDeviceMid();
110:   const label = `zcode-local${userId ? `-${userId}` : ''}`;
111:   return {
112:     label,
113:     edition: 'zcode',
114:     mode: 'jwt',
115:     token: jwt,
116:     refreshToken: null,   // 客户端 bigmodel OAuth 流程不返回 refresh_token
117:     expiredAt: null,      // JWT 无 exp 字段，长期有效
118:     userId,
119:     host: 'https://zcode.z.ai',
120:     source: 'local',
121:     fingerprint: require('./fingerprint').forHost(deviceMid),
122:   };
123: }
124: 
125: /** JWT payload 的 user_id（缺失时回退 sub）。 */
126: function jwtUserId(token) {
127:   const t = String(token || '').trim();
128:   if (!t) return null;
129:   const seg = t.split('.')[1];
130:   if (!seg) return null;
131:   try {
132:     const payload = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(seg, 'base64url').toString('utf-8'));
133:     const uid = payload.user_id || payload.sub;
134:     return uid != null && String(uid).trim() ? String(uid).trim() : null;
135:   } catch {
136:     return null;
137:   }
138: }
139: 
140: module.exports = {
141:   PREFIX,
142:   credentialsPath,
143:   telemetryPath,
144:   deriveSecret,
145:   decryptField,
146:   isClientInstalled,
147:   readLocalCredentials,
148:   readDeviceMid,
149:   buildAccountFromLocal,
150:   jwtUserId,
151: };

* 沿用真实 deviceMid 与宿主平台形态，比随机生成伦敦的 Mac 更少设备维度风险
* （客户端自己上报的激活/日活事件用的就是这个 deviceMid）。
if (!jwt) throw new Error('本机凭据中无 zcodejwttoken（客户端可能未完成登录）');
refreshToken: null,   // 客户端 bigmodel OAuth 流程不返回 refresh_token
expiredAt: null,      // JWT 无 exp 字段，长期有效
/** JWT payload 的 user_id（缺失时回退 sub）。 */
return uid != null && String(uid).trim() ? String(uid).trim() : null;

1: 'use strict';
2: /**
3:  * models/official-daily.js — 官方账单的「按日」聚合。
4:  *
5:  * 用途：traffic.jsonl 的 token 字段在 2026-10-10 前被误脱敏成 "***"（且 10-04/10-05
6:  * 无数值行），网关侧计量在那段日期是空的。官方账单缓存（Trae 会话账单 + WorkBuddy
7:  * 逐请求账单）覆盖同样的日期且是上游权威口径，按日聚合后正好补上这个洞。
8:  *
9:  * 两个数据源已在各自模块缓存到文件（trae-usage-cache 与 official-usage-cache），
10:  * 这里只读文件聚合，不请求上游。
11:  */
12: const fs = require('fs');
13: const path = require('path');
14: const { stateDir, legacyStateDir } = require('../lib/paths');
15: const { round2 } = require('../lib/round');
16: 
17: function cacheDirOf(name) {
18:   const fresh = path.join(stateDir(), name);
19:   if (fs.existsSync(fresh)) return fresh;
20:   const legacy = path.join(legacyStateDir(), name);
21:   return fs.existsSync(legacy) ? legacy : fresh;
22: }
23: 
24: const traeDir = () => cacheDirOf('trae-usage-cache');
25: const wbDir = () => cacheDirOf('official-usage-cache');
26: 
27: function readRowsMatching(dir, suffix) {
28:   if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return [];
29:   const out = [];
30:   for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)) {
31:     if (!f.endsWith(suffix)) continue;
32:     try {
33:       const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, f), 'utf-8'));
34:       for (const r of raw.rows || []) out.push(r);
35:     } catch { /* 单文件损坏跳过 */ }
36:   }
37:   return out;
38: }
39: 
40: /**
41:  * 聚合最近 N 天的官方账单积分（按日）。
42:  * @param {number} days
43:  * @returns {{byDay: {date:string, traeCredit:number, traeTokens:number, traeSessions:number, wbCredit:number, wbRequests:number, totalCredit:number, covered:boolean}[], traeCreditTotal:number, wbCreditTotal:number}}
44:  *   covered=true 表示该日两路账单缓存都存在（不代表有消耗，只代表「查过且入账」）；
45:  *   Trae 账单按会话入账有 1~2 天滞后，最近一两天 traeCredit=0 多半是未入账，不是没消耗。
46:  */
47: function dailyCredits(days) {
48:   const byDay = new Map();
49:   const dayKey = (offset) => {
50:     const d = new Date();
51:     d.setDate(d.getDate() - offset);
52:     const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
53:     return `${d.getFullYear()}-${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${p(d.getDate())}`;
54:   };
55:   for (let i = 0; i < days; i++) {
56:     byDay.set(dayKey(i), {
57:       date: dayKey(i),
58:       traeCredit: 0, traeTokens: 0, traeSessions: 0,
59:       wbCredit: 0, wbRequests: 0,
60:       totalCredit: 0,
61:       covered: false,
62:     });
63:   }
64:   const daySet = new Set(byDay.keys());
65: 
66:   // Trae 会话账单：缓存文件名 <accountId>-<date>.json
67:   const tdir = traeDir();
68:   const traeDays = new Set();
69:   if (fs.existsSync(tdir)) {
70:     for (const f of fs.readdirSync(tdir)) {
71:       const m = f.match(/-(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\.json$/);
72:       if (!m || !daySet.has(m[1])) continue;
73:       traeDays.add(m[1]);
74:       const bucket = byDay.get(m[1]);
75:       try {
76:         for (const r of JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(tdir, f), 'utf-8')).rows || []) {
77:           bucket.traeCredit += Number(r.credits) || 0;
78:           bucket.traeTokens += (Number(r.inputTokens) || 0) + (Number(r.outputTokens) || 0);
79:           bucket.traeSessions++;
80:         }
81:       } catch { /* 单文件损坏跳过 */ }
82:     }
83:   }
84: 
85:   // WorkBuddy 逐请求账单：同命名规则
86:   const wdir = wbDir();
87:   const wbDays = new Set();
88:   if (fs.existsSync(wdir)) {
89:     for (const f of fs.readdirSync(wdir)) {
90:       const m = f.match(/-(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\.json$/);
91:       if (!m || !daySet.has(m[1])) continue;
92:       wbDays.add(m[1]);
93:       const bucket = byDay.get(m[1]);
94:       try {
95:         for (const r of JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(wdir, f), 'utf-8')).rows || []) {
96:           bucket.wbCredit += Number(r.credit) || 0;
97:           bucket.wbRequests++;
98:         }
99:       } catch { /* 单文件损坏跳过 */ }
100:     }
101:   }
102: 
103:   let traeCreditTotal = 0;
104:   let wbCreditTotal = 0;
105:   const out = [...byDay.values()].sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date));
106:   for (const d of out) {
107:     d.traeCredit = round2(d.traeCredit);
108:     d.wbCredit = round2(d.wbCredit);
109:     d.totalCredit = round2(d.traeCredit + d.wbCredit);
110:     d.traeTokens = Math.round(d.traeTokens);
111:     traeCreditTotal += d.traeCredit;
112:     wbCreditTotal += d.wbCredit;
113:     // covered：该日已有账单缓存文件（读取成功）。不代表当日一定有消耗——
114:     // Trae 按会话入账有 1~2 天滞后，最近一两日 traeCredit=0 多半是「尚未入账」，
115:     // 调用方须结合该事实解读，不可读作「当天没花积分」。
116:     d.covered = traeDays.has(d.date) || wbDays.has(d.date);
117:   }
118:   return {
119:     byDay: out,
120:     traeCreditTotal: round2(traeCreditTotal),
121:     wbCreditTotal: round2(wbCreditTotal),
122:   };
123: }
124: 
125: module.exports = { dailyCredits };

1: 'use strict';
2: /**
3:  * upstream/checkin.js — Trae 每日签到（status / claim）。
4:  * 域：默认 https://api.trae.cn（UG），与 agent mchost 分离；可用 TRAE_UG_HOST 覆盖。
5:  *
6:  * 上游为设备维度限签：同 x-device-id 当日仅可 claim 一次。
7:  * 业务判定必须看 data.code（HTTP 200 仍可能是 9095 已签到）。
8:  */
9: const store = require('../credentials/store');
10: const auth = require('../auth');
11: const legacy = require('../lib/auth');
12: const headersLib = require('../lib/headers');
13: const { ensureAccountDevices } = require('../credentials/import');
14: const { sleep, runPlanned, localDateKey } = require('../lib/util');
15: const variant = require('../platform/variant');
16: 
17: // 域名与业务码统一从 platform/variant.js 取（单一事实源）
18: const DEFAULT_UG_HOST = variant.variantOf(variant.TRAE).hosts.ug;
19: const TIMEOUT_MS = 15000;
20: const CLAIM_GAP_MS = 2500;
21: const RATE_RETRY = 3;
22: /** 9074 实测较顽固，退避需拉长；第 1/2/3 次重试约 +5 s/+10 s/+20 s。 */
23: const RATE_RETRY_DELAY_MS = 5000;
24: 
25: /** 上游业务码：设备/账号今日已签到。 */
26: const CODE_ALREADY = variant.variantOf(variant.TRAE).errors.alreadyCheckedIn[0];
27: /** 上游业务码：参与用户过多，可稍后重试。 */
28: const CODE_BUSY = variant.variantOf(variant.TRAE).errors.busy;
29: const PATHS = variant.variantOf(variant.TRAE).paths;
30: const ERRORS = variant.variantOf(variant.TRAE).errors;
31: 
32: function ugHost() {
33:   if (process.env.TRAE_UG_HOST) return process.env.TRAE_UG_HOST.replace(/\/$/, '');
34:   return DEFAULT_UG_HOST;
35: }
36: 
37: async function postUg(acct, apiPath) {
38:   const url = ugHost() + apiPath;
39:   const headers = headersLib.buildCommonHeaders({
40:     token: acct.token,
41:     userId: acct.userId,
42:     devices: acct.devices,
43:     // 版本指纹缺失时按登录态选 CN/SG 内置默认值
44:     _edition: acct.edition || 'cn',
45:   });
46:   const resp = await fetch(url, {
47:     method: 'POST',
48:     headers,
49:     body: JSON.stringify({}),
50:     signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TIMEOUT_MS),
51:   });
52:   let data = null;
53:   try { data = await resp.json(); } catch { data = null; }
54:   return { ok: resp.ok, status: resp.status, data, url };
55: }
56: 
57: /**
58:  * 解析 status/claim 业务响应。
59:  * @returns {{code:number, message:string, enable:boolean, checkedIn:boolean, credits:number|null, raw:object}}
60:  */
61: function pickCheckinFields(data) {
62:   const root = (data && typeof data === 'object') ? data : {};
63:   // 兼容 data.data 包裹；无 data 包裹时直接用根对象
64:   const d = (root.data && typeof root.data === 'object') ? root.data : root;
65:   const code = Number(root.code ?? d.code ?? 0);
66:   const message = String(root.message ?? d.message ?? root.msg ?? d.msg ?? '');
67:   // checked_in 表示本账号今日是否已签；did_checked_in 仅作缺省取值，避免设备侧字段抢占
68:   let checkedIn;
69:   if (d.checked_in !== undefined) checkedIn = !!d.checked_in;
70:   else if (d.checkedIn !== undefined) checkedIn = !!d.checkedIn;
71:   else checkedIn = !!(d.did_checked_in ?? d.didCheckedIn);
72:   const enable = d.enable !== false && d.enabled !== false;
73:   const credits = typeof d.credits === 'number'
74:     ? d.credits
75:     : (typeof root.credits === 'number' ? root.credits : null);
76:   return {
77:     code: Number.isFinite(code) ? code : 0,
78:     message,
79:     enable,
80:     checkedIn,
81:     credits,
82:     raw: root,
83:   };
84: }
85: 
86: /** 是否为「今日/设备已签到」类业务失败（非系统错误）。 */
87: function isAlreadyCode(code, message) {
88:   if (code === CODE_ALREADY) return true;
89:   const m = String(message || '');
90:   return (ERRORS.alreadyText || []).some((x) => m.includes(x));
91: }
92: 
93: function alreadyResult(acctId, label, note, checkinCredits, at, resultTag) {
94:   store.update(acctId, {
95:     lastCheckinAt: at,
96:     lastCheckinResult: resultTag,
97:   });
98:   return {
99:     accountId: acctId,
100:     label,
101:     checkedIn: true,
102:     enable: true,
103:     checkinCredits,
104:     claimed: false,
105:     at,
106:     note,
107:     result: resultTag,
108:   };
109: }
110: 
111: /** claim code=0 后回读 status，确认账号级已签，避免误标 claimed。 */
112: async function confirmCheckedIn(acct) {
113:   try {
114:     const st = await postUg(acct, PATHS.checkinStatus);
115:     if (!st.ok) return null;
116:     const fields = pickCheckinFields(st.data);
117:     if (fields.code !== 0) return fields;
118:     return fields;
119:   } catch (e) {
120:     console.warn(`[checkin] confirm status fail account=${acct.id}: ${e.message}`);
121:     return null;
122:   }
123: }
124: 
125: /**
126:  * 对单个账号执行：确保 token → status → 未领取则 claim。
127:  * 成功仅当 claim 业务码为 0；9095 归为 already/device_already，不报成功领取。
128:  * @param {string} accountId
129:  * @returns {Promise<object>}
130:  */
131: async function checkinAccount(accountId) {
132:   const stored = store.get(accountId);
133:   if (!stored) throw new Error(`account not found: ${accountId}`);
134:   if (stored.enabled === false) throw new Error('account disabled');
135:   // 平台闸门：批量入口已按 isTrae 过滤，单账号入口（面板按钮 / API）也必须挡，
136:   // 否则对 ZCode 账号点「签到」会拿它的 JWT 去打 Trae 的签到端点
137:   if (!variant.isTrae(stored.edition)) {
138:     throw new Error(`not a trae account (edition=${stored.edition || 'null'})`);
139:   }
140: 
141:   const authInfo = await auth.ensureAuth(accountId);
142:   let acct = { ...stored, ...authInfo };
143:   if (!acct.token) throw new Error('account has no token');
144: 
145:   // 旧账号 devices 缺失时先回填，避免多账号共用本机指纹导致只能签一次
146:   if (!acct.devices || !acct.devices.machineId || !acct.devices.devDeviceId) {
147:     ensureAccountDevices(acct.id);
148:     acct = { ...acct, ...(store.get(acct.id) || {}) };
149:   }
150: 
151:   const st = await postUg(acct, PATHS.checkinStatus);
152:   if (!st.ok) {
153:     console.error(`[checkin] status HTTP ${st.status} account=${acct.id}`);
154:     throw new Error(`checkin status failed: HTTP ${st.status}`);
155:   }
156:   const status = pickCheckinFields(st.data);
157:   if (status.code !== 0) {
158:     console.error(`[checkin] status code=${status.code} account=${acct.id} msg=${status.message}`);
159:     throw new Error(`checkin status failed: code=${status.code} ${status.message}`.trim());
160:   }
161: 
162:   const result = {
163:     accountId: acct.id,
164:     label: acct.label || acct.id,
165:     checkedIn: status.checkedIn,
166:     enable: status.enable,
167:     checkinCredits: status.credits,
168:     claimed: false,
169:     at: new Date().toISOString(),
170:   };
171: 
172:   if (!status.enable) {
173:     store.update(acct.id, {
174:       lastCheckinAt: result.at,
175:       lastCheckinResult: 'disabled',
176:     });
177:     result.note = 'checkin disabled for account/activity';
178:     result.result = 'disabled';
179:     return result;
180:   }
181: 
182:   // 今日已签（账号或设备）：不再 claim，避免误报成功
183:   if (status.checkedIn) {
184:     store.update(acct.id, {
185:       lastCheckinAt: result.at,
186:       lastCheckinResult: 'already',
187:     });
188:     result.note = 'already checked in';
189:     result.result = 'already';
190:     return result;
191:   }
192: 
193:   // claim：对 9074（人多/节流）指数退避重试；其余业务错误直接失败
194:   let claim = null;
195:   let claimed = null;
196:   for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= RATE_RETRY; attempt++) {
197:     if (attempt > 0) {
198:       const delay = RATE_RETRY_DELAY_MS * (2 ** (attempt - 1));
199:       console.warn(`[checkin] claim busy code=${CODE_BUSY} wait ${delay}ms retry ${attempt}/${RATE_RETRY} account=${acct.id}`);
200:       await sleep(delay);
201:     }
202:     claim = await postUg(acct, PATHS.checkinClaim);
203:     if (!claim.ok) {
204:       console.error(`[checkin] claim HTTP ${claim.status} account=${acct.id}`);
205:       store.update(acct.id, { lastCheckinAt: result.at, lastCheckinResult: `claim_http_${claim.status}` });
206:       const err = new Error(`checkin claim failed: HTTP ${claim.status}`);
207:       err.status = claim.status;
208:       throw err;
209:     }
210:     claimed = pickCheckinFields(claim.data);
211:     if (claimed.code === CODE_BUSY && attempt < RATE_RETRY) continue;
212:     break;
213:   }
214: 
215:   // HTTP 200 + 9095：设备/今日已签，不能算 claimed
216:   if (claimed.code !== 0) {
217:     const at = result.at;
218:     if (isAlreadyCode(claimed.code, claimed.message)) {
219:       const note = claimed.message || 'already checked in (device/account)';
220:       console.warn(`[checkin] claim already code=${claimed.code} account=${acct.id} ${note}`);
221:       return alreadyResult(
222:         acct.id,
223:         result.label,
224:         note,
225:         status.credits,
226:         at,
227:         claimed.code === CODE_ALREADY ? 'device_already' : 'already',
228:       );
229:     }
230:     store.update(acct.id, {
231:       lastCheckinAt: at,
232:       lastCheckinResult: `claim_code_${claimed.code}`,
233:     });
234:     console.error(`[checkin] claim code=${claimed.code} account=${acct.id} msg=${claimed.message}`);
235:     const err = new Error(`checkin claim failed: code=${claimed.code} ${claimed.message}`.trim());
236:     err.status = claim.status;
237:     throw err;
238:   }
239: 
240:   // code=0 后回读 status：若账号级仍为未签，不标 claimed（防假成功）
241:   const confirmed = await confirmCheckedIn(acct);
242:   if (confirmed && confirmed.code === 0 && confirmed.checkedIn === false) {
243:     console.warn(`[checkin] claim code=0 but status still unchecked account=${acct.id}`);
244:     store.update(acct.id, {
245:       lastCheckinAt: result.at,
246:       lastCheckinResult: 'claim_unconfirmed',
247:     });
248:     const err = new Error('checkin claim returned success but status still unchecked');
249:     throw err;
250:   }
251: 
252:   store.update(acct.id, {
253:     lastCheckinAt: result.at,
254:     lastCheckinResult: 'claimed',
255:   });
256:   result.claimed = true;
257:   result.checkedIn = true;
258:   result.result = 'claimed';
259:   // 签到积分仅在 result 中返回，不写 balance（balance=权益剩余）
260:   if (claimed.credits != null) result.checkinCredits = claimed.credits;
261:   else if (status.credits != null) result.checkinCredits = status.credits;
262:   if (confirmed && confirmed.credits != null) result.checkinCredits = confirmed.credits;
263:   return result;
264: }
265: 
266: /**
267:  * 对所有 enabled 的 Trae 账号签到。
268:  *
269:  * 默认按（本地日期, 账号 id）确定性错峰：账号在同一时间窗内分散触发，
270:  * 避免固定时刻批量请求上游自造洪峰；窗口由 checkinSpreadMinutes 控制
271:  * （0 = 关闭，退回原先的立即顺序执行）。
272:  *
273:  * 错峰偏移与调用时刻无关，因此同日重跑（手动触发、重启后补跑）会落在
274:  * 同一时刻，天然幂等；上游另有「已签到」业务码作最后保障，重复调用不会重复领取。
275:  *
276:  * @param {{windowStartMs?:number, spreadMinutes?:number}} [opts]
277:  */
278: async function checkinAllEnabled(opts = {}) {
279:   // 只跑 Trae 系账号（显式白名单）。不能写 edition !== 'workbuddy'：
280:   // 否则会把新平台（如 zcode）的账号误抓进 Trae 签到链。
281:   const accounts = store.list().filter((a) => a.enabled && variant.isTrae(a.edition));
282:   const claimed = [];

89: async function runRewards(opts = {}) {

139:       for (const f of r.failed || []) {

141:       }

155:     ? 0

220: /** 计算「今天/明天 HH:mm」的下一时刻。 */
221: function nextAt(hour, minute) {
222:   const now = new Date();
223:   const d = new Date(now);
224:   d.setHours(hour, minute, 0, 0);
225:   if (d.getTime() <= now.getTime()) d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1);
226:   return d;
227: }
228: 
229: function scheduleOnce(hour, minute, label) {
230:   const at = nextAt(hour, minute);
231:   if (!state.nextRunAt || at.getTime() < new Date(state.nextRunAt).getTime()) {
232:     state.nextRunAt = at.toISOString();
233:   }
234:   const delay = Math.max(1000, at.getTime() - Date.now());
235:   const t = setTimeout(async () => {
236:     state.nextRunAt = null;
237:     try {
238:       await runRewards({ trigger: 'scheduler' });
239:     } catch { /* logged inside */ }
240:     if (started) {
241:       const eff = getEffective();
242:       scheduleOnce(hour, minute, label);
243:       void eff;
244:     }
245:   }, delay);
246:   t.unref?.();
247:   timers.push(t);
248:   console.log(`[zcode-rewards] next ${label} at ${at.toISOString()} (in ${Math.round(delay / 1000)}s)`);
249: }
250: 
251: /** 注册每日两个时段（restart 会先清空重排）。 */
252: function schedule() {
253:   for (const t of timers) clearTimeout(t);
254:   timers = [];
255:   state.nextRunAt = null;
256:   const eff = getEffective();
257:   scheduleOnce(eff.hour1, eff.minute1, 'slot-1');
258:   scheduleOnce(eff.hour2, eff.minute2, 'slot-2');
259: }
260: 
261: function start() {
262:   stop();
263:   const eff = getEffective();
264:   if (!eff.enabled) {
265:     console.log('[zcode-rewards] disabled (ZCODE_REWARDS_ENABLED=false 或未配置)');
266:     return;
267:   }
268:   started = true;
269:   schedule();
270: }
271: 
272: function stop() {
273:   started = false;
274:   for (const t of timers) clearTimeout(t);
275:   timers = [];
276:   state.nextRunAt = null;
277: }
278: 
279: /** 配置变更后重排。 */
280: function restart() {
281:   stop();
282:   start();
283:   return snapshot();
284: }
285: 
286: function snapshot() {
287:   return {
288:     ...getEffective(),
289:     ...state,
290:     solver: solverStatus(),
291:     accounts: zcodeAccounts().length,
292:   };
293: }
294: 
295: module.exports = {
296:   SPECS,
297:   getEffective,
298:   save,
299:   runRewards,
300:   start,
301:   stop,
302:   restart,
303:   snapshot,
304:   zcodeAccounts,
305:   solverStatus,
306:   FILE: () => storeSettings.FILE(),
307: };

23: // Anthropic block 转文本
24: function blockToText(block) {
25:   if (typeof block === 'string') return block;
26:   if (block.type === 'text') return block.text || '';
27:   if (block.type === 'tool_result') {
28:     const c = block.content;
29:     return Array.isArray(c) ? c.map((x) => (typeof x === 'string' ? x : x.text || '')).join('\n') : String(c || '');
30:   }
31:   return '';
32: }

34: // Anthropic messages → OpenAI 风格，保留 tool_use / tool_result 原生结构
35: function anthropicToOpenAI(messages) {
36:   const out = [];
37:   for (const m of messages || []) {
38:     if (m.role === 'assistant') {
39:       const contentBlocks = Array.isArray(m.content) ? m.content : [{ type: 'text', text: m.content }];
40:       const text = contentBlocks.filter((b) => b.type === 'text').map((b) => b.text || '').join('');
41:       const toolUses = contentBlocks.filter((b) => b.type === 'tool_use');
42:       const msg = { role: 'assistant' };
43:       const tool_calls = toolUses.map((b) => ({
44:         id: b.id || 'call_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8),
45:         type: 'function',
46:         function_call: { name: b.name, arguments: JSON.stringify(b.input || {}) },
47:       }));
48:       if (tool_calls.length) { msg.content = []; msg.tool_calls = tool_calls; }
49:       else msg.content = text ? [{ type: 'text', text }] : [];
50:       out.push(msg);
51:     } else if (m.role === 'user') {
52:       const blocks = Array.isArray(m.content) ? m.content : [{ type: 'text', text: m.content }];
53:       // tool_result 视作 tool 消息
54:       if (blocks.some((b) => b.type === 'tool_result')) {
55:         for (const b of blocks) {
56:           if (b.type === 'tool_result') {
57:             out.push({ role: 'tool', tool_call_id: b.tool_use_id || '', content: [{ type: 'text', text: blockToText(b) }] });
58:           } else {
59:             out.push({ role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text: blockToText(b) }] });
60:           }
61:         }
62:       } else {
63:         out.push({ role: 'user', content: blocks.map((b) => ({ type: 'text', text: blockToText(b) })).filter((b) => b.text) });
64:       }
65:     } else {
66:       out.push({ role: m.role, content: [{ type: 'text', text: blockToText(m.content) }] });
67:     }
68:   }
69:   return out;
70: }

1: 'use strict';
2: /**
3:  * jobs/growth-auto.js — WorkBuddy 成长中心全自动编排。
4:  *
5:  * 对每个启用的 WorkBuddy 账号按顺序执行（各段独立 try，一段失败不影响其余）：
6:  *   1. 旅行：state 权威三态 → arrived 领奖 / traveling 等待 / idle 派出发 / 已达次数收工
7:  *   2. 任务：available 接单 → completed 领奖
8:  *   3. 补登：有卡且有可补日期时用卡（每轮最多 1 张；候选日若上游判定未断登则跳过，不算失败）
9:  *   4. 连登兑换：非 claimed/locked 的档位尝试兑换（403 未解锁、409 已兑换均为业务常态）
10:  *   5. 抽奖：有次数才抽（每轮最多 1 次，写路径不可逆）
11:  *   6. Buddy 盲盒：能量够 cost_per_open 才开
12:  * 所有写接口带 client_token 幂等键；结果汇总返回，供路由与通知使用。
13:  */
14: const store = require('../credentials/store');
15: const auth = require('../auth');
16: const wbAuth = require('../workbuddy/auth');
17: const g = require('../workbuddy/cat-trip');
18: const { sleep } = require('../lib/util');

28: const RUN_LOG = () => stateFile('growth-last-run.json');
29: const readRunLog = () => resolveStateFileForRead('growth-last-run.json', fs.existsSync);

31: /** 记录上次运行结果（供前端 last_run 展示）。 */
32: function saveLastRun(summary) {
33:   writeJsonAtomic(RUN_LOG(), summary);
34: }

46: /** 账号 → 上游 info（ensureAuth 按 edition 刷新 token）。 */
47: async function toInfo(accountId) {
48:   const stored = store.get(accountId);
49:   const ensured = await auth.ensureAuth(accountId);
50:   return {
51:     accessToken: ensured.token || stored.token,
52:     refreshToken: ensured.refreshToken || stored.refreshToken,
53:     uid: ensured.userId || stored.userId,
54:     region: wbAuth.regionOf(ensured.host || stored.host),
55:   };
56: }

58: /** 单个账号的完整成长中心自动化。返回该账号的动作清单。 */
59: async function runAccount(a, opts = {}) {
60:   const locationId = Number(opts.location_id) > 0 ? Number(opts.location_id) : 1;
61:   const durationHours = Number(opts.duration_hours) > 0 ? Number(opts.duration_hours) : 4;
62:   const actions = [];
63:   const label = a.label || a.id;
64:   const info = await toInfo(a.id);
65: 
66:   // 1) 旅行
67:   try {
68:     const st = await g.fetchStatus(info);
69:     if (!st.ok) {
70:       actions.push({ seg: 'travel', ok: false, msg: st.reason || 'status fail' });
71:     } else if (st.state === 'arrived') {
72:       const c = await g.claimTravelReward(info);
73:       if (c.ok) {
74:         actions.push({ seg: 'travel', ok: true, msg: `领取旅行奖励 +${c.rewardCredit ?? 0}` });
75:         notify('growth_claimed', { accountId: a.id, label, message: `旅行奖励已领取 +${c.rewardCredit ?? 0}` }, 'WorkBuddy 旅行奖励已领取').catch(() => {});
76:       } else {
77:         actions.push({ seg: 'travel', ok: false, msg: `领奖失败：${c.reason || c.result}` });
78:       }
79:     } else if (st.state === 'traveling') {
80:       actions.push({ seg: 'travel', ok: true, skip: true, msg: `旅行中（${st.location ? st.location.name : ''}）` });
81:     } else if (st.state === 'idle' && !st.dailyLimitReached) {
82:       const d = await g.depart(info, { location_id: locationId, duration_hours: durationHours });
83:       if (d.ok) {
84:         actions.push({ seg: 'travel', ok: true, msg: `派猫出发 ${d.location ? d.location.name : ''}（预计 +${d.rewardCredit ?? 0}）` });
85:         notify('growth_departed', { accountId: a.id, label, message: `已派猫出发（${d.location ? d.location.name : ''}）` }, 'WorkBuddy 派猫出发').catch(() => {});
86:       } else {
87:         actions.push({ seg: 'travel', ok: false, msg: `出发失败：${d.reason || d.result}` });
88:       }
89:     } else {
90:       actions.push({ seg: 'travel', ok: true, skip: true, msg: '今日旅行已完成' });
91:     }
92:   } catch (e) { actions.push({ seg: 'travel', ok: false, msg: e.message }); }
93: 
94:   // 2) 任务：available 接单 + completed 领奖
95:   try {
96:     const t = await g.fetchTasks(info);
97:     if (!t.ok) {
98:       actions.push({ seg: 'tasks', ok: false, msg: t.reason || 'tasks fail' });
99:     } else {
100:       const pending = t.tasks.filter((x) => x.status === 'available' && x.code).map((x) => x.code);
101:       if (pending.length) {
102:         const ar = await g.acceptTasks(info, pending);
103:         if (ar.ok) {
104:           const bad = ar.results.filter((r) => r.status === 'error');
105:           actions.push({ seg: 'tasks', ok: true, msg: `接单 ${ar.results.length - bad.length}/${ar.results.length}${bad.length ? `（${bad.length} 项未就绪）` : ''}` });
106:         } else {
107:           actions.push({ seg: 'tasks', ok: false, msg: `接单失败：${ar.reason}` });
108:         }
109:       }
110:       // 领奖只针对 status=completed 且 code 存在的真实任务；不对未完成任务上报伪造事件
111:       let claimed = 0;
112:       let skippedPending = 0;
113:       for (const task of t.tasks) {
114:         if (task.status !== 'completed' || !task.code) continue;
115:         const cr = await g.claimTask(info, task.code);
116:         if (cr.ok && !cr.alreadyClaimed) claimed += 1;
117:         await sleep(200);
118:       }
119:       // 未完成任务（available、processing 等）如实标注「需真实操作」，不做 best-effort 上报
120:       for (const task of t.tasks) {
121:         if (task.status === 'completed' || task.status === 'available') continue;
122:         skippedPending += 1;
123:       }
124:       if (claimed) actions.push({ seg: 'tasks', ok: true, msg: `任务领奖 ×${claimed}` });
125:       if (skippedPending) {
126:         actions.push({ seg: 'tasks', ok: true, skip: true, msg: `${skippedPending} 项任务待真实操作（仅领取已完成）` });
127:       }
128:     }
129:   } catch (e) { actions.push({ seg: 'tasks', ok: false, msg: e.message }); }
130: 
131:   // 3) 补登卡（每轮最多 1 张；not_broken = 该日本来就已签，属常态跳过）
132:   try {
133:     const s = await g.fetchStreak(info);
134:     if (s.ok && s.makeupCards > 0 && s.makeupDates.length) {
135:       let done = false;
136:       let stale = 0;
137:       let errMsg = null;
138:       for (const date of s.makeupDates) {
139:         if (done) break;
140:         const mr = await g.useMakeupCard(info, date);
141:         if (mr.ok) {
142:           actions.push({ seg: 'makeup', ok: true, msg: `补登 ${date}（剩 ${mr.cardsLeft ?? '?'} 张）` });
143:           done = true;
144:         } else if (mr.result === 'not_broken') {
145:           stale += 1;
146:         } else {
147:           errMsg = `补登失败：${mr.reason}`;
148:           break;
149:         }
150:         await sleep(200);
151:       }
152:       if (!done && errMsg) actions.push({ seg: 'makeup', ok: false, msg: errMsg });
153:       else if (!done && stale) actions.push({ seg: 'makeup', ok: true, skip: true, msg: `${stale} 个候选日本就已签，无需补登` });
154:     }
155:   } catch (e) { actions.push({ seg: 'makeup', ok: false, msg: e.message }); }
156: 
157:   // 4) 连登兑换
158:   try {
159:     const rs = await g.fetchRedeemSummary(info);
160:     if (rs.ok) {
161:       for (const t of rs.tiers) {
162:         if (!t.status || t.status === 'claimed' || t.status === 'locked') continue;
163:         const rr = await g.redeemTier(info, t.tier);
164:         if (rr.ok) {
165:           actions.push({ seg: 'redeem', ok: true, msg: `兑换 ${t.tier}（+credit${rr.credit ?? 0} +energy${rr.energy ?? 0}）` });
166:           notify('growth_claimed', { accountId: a.id, label, message: `连登兑换 ${t.tier} 成功` }, 'WorkBuddy 连登兑换').catch(() => {});
167:         } else if (rr.result === 'tier_locked' || rr.result === 'already_redeemed') {
168:           actions.push({ seg: 'redeem', ok: true, skip: true, msg: `${t.tier} ${rr.result}` });
169:         } else {
170:           actions.push({ seg: 'redeem', ok: false, msg: `${t.tier} 失败：${rr.reason}` });
171:         }
172:         await sleep(300);
173:       }
174:     }
175:   } catch (e) { actions.push({ seg: 'redeem', ok: false, msg: e.message }); }
176: 
177:   // 5) 抽奖（每轮最多 1 次）
178:   try {
179:     const lc = await g.fetchLotteryChances(info);
180:     if (lc.ok && lc.balance > 0) {
181:       const dr = await g.drawLottery(info);
182:       if (dr.ok) {
183:         const extra = dr.needAddress ? '（实物奖，需到成长中心填收件信息）' : '';
184:         actions.push({ seg: 'lottery', ok: true, msg: `开盲盒获得：${dr.prize || '未知'}${extra}` });
185:         if (lc.balance > 1) actions.push({ seg: 'lottery', ok: true, skip: true, msg: `还剩 ${lc.balance - 1} 次，下轮继续` });
186:       } else if (dr.result === 'no_chance') {
187:         actions.push({ seg: 'lottery', ok: true, skip: true, msg: '无抽奖机会' });
188:       } else {
189:         actions.push({ seg: 'lottery', ok: false, msg: `抽奖失败：${dr.reason}` });
190:       }
191:     }
192:   } catch (e) { actions.push({ seg: 'lottery', ok: false, msg: e.message }); }
193: 
194:   // 6) Buddy 盲盒（能量足够才开）
195:   try {
196:     const q = await g.fetchBuddyQuota(info);
197:     if (q.ok && q.affordable > 0) {
198:       const count = Math.min(q.affordable, q.maxOpenCount || 1);
199:       const ob = await g.openBuddyBox(info, count);
200:       if (ob.ok) actions.push({ seg: 'buddy', ok: true, msg: `开 Buddy 盲盒 ×${ob.count}${ob.names.length ? `（${ob.names.join('、')}）` : ''}` });
201:       else actions.push({ seg: 'buddy', ok: false, msg: `开箱失败：${ob.reason}` });
202:     }
203:   } catch (e) { actions.push({ seg: 'buddy', ok: false, msg: e.message }); }
204: 
205:   const okAll = actions.every((x) => x.ok);
206:   return { accountId: a.id, label, ok: okAll, actions };
207: }

1: 'use strict';
2: /**
3:  * credentials/import.js — 凭据导入（面向「免本机登录」）。
4:  *
5:  * 允许从多种来源导入 Trae 账号凭据并写入 SQLite 存储，无需本机登录：
6:  *  - storageJsonText：上传的 storage.json 原始文本（自动解密 iCubeAuthInfo，并抽取 telemetry 设备指纹）
7:  *  - authObject：已解密的认证对象 { token, refreshToken, userId, ... }
8:  *  - refreshToken：仅 refreshToken 字符串（后续自动 ExchangeToken 续期）
9:  *
10:  * 设备指纹：上游签到按设备限次。导入或回填时保证每账号有独立 devices，避免共享本机指纹。
11:  */
12: const crypto = require('crypto');
13: const store = require('./store');
14: const traeDecrypt = require('../lib/trae-decrypt.js');
15: const { hashDeviceId } = require('../lib/util');
16: 
17: function pick(obj, keys) {
18:   const out = {};
19:   for (const k of keys) if (obj && obj[k] != null) out[k] = obj[k];
20:   return out;
21: }
22: 
23: /** 校验是否能拿到有效 token 或 refreshToken；两者皆无则拒绝。 */
24: function hasCredibleToken(auth) {
25:   return !!(auth.token || auth.refreshToken);
26: }
27: 
28: /** 解析 storage.json 文本为对象。 */
29: function parseStorageJson(text) {
30:   if (!text || typeof text !== 'string') throw new Error('storage.json content is required');
31:   return JSON.parse(text);
32: }
33: 
34: /** 从 storage.json 原始文本提取 iCubeAuthInfo（自动解密 tc 加密/明文）。 */
35: function authFromStorageJson(text) {
36:   const storage = parseStorageJson(text);
37:   const key = 'iCubeAuthInfo://icube.cloudide';
38:   const raw = storage[key];
39:   if (!raw) throw new Error(`key "${key}" not found in storage.json`);
40:   const s = String(raw).trim();
41:   if (s.startsWith('{') || s.startsWith('"')) return JSON.parse(raw);
42:   const decrypted = traeDecrypt.decryptStorageValue(raw);
43:   return JSON.parse(decrypted);
44: }
45: 
46: /** 生成稳定且互不相同的账号级设备指纹。字段形态参照真实 Trae telemetry。 */
47: function genDevices(seed) {
48:   const h = (v) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(String(v)).digest('hex');
49:   const base = seed != null && seed !== '' ? String(seed) : crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
50:   const machineId = h(`machine:${base}`);
51:   return {
52:     machineId,
53:     sqmId: guidBraced(h(`sqm:${base}`)),
54:     devDeviceId: uuidLoose(h(`dev:${base}`)),
55:     // 与 lib/auth.hashDeviceId 输出形态一致：最多 19 位十进制（前导零常见）
56:     deviceId: hashDeviceId(machineId),
57:     deviceModel: process.env.TRAE_DEVICE_MODEL || '82RF',
58:     osName: process.env.TRAE_OS_NAME || 'windows',
59:     osVersion: process.env.TRAE_OS_VERSION || 'Windows 10',
60:     cpu: process.env.TRAE_CPU || 'Intel',
61:   };
62: }
63: 
64: function guidBraced(hex) {
65:   const h = (String(hex) + '0'.repeat(32)).slice(0, 32).toUpperCase();
66:   return `{${h.slice(0, 8)}-${h.slice(8, 12)}-${h.slice(12, 16)}-${h.slice(16, 20)}-${h.slice(20, 32)}}`;
67: }
68: 
69: function uuidLoose(hex) {
70:   const h = (String(hex) + '0'.repeat(32)).slice(0, 32).toLowerCase();
71:   return `${h.slice(0, 8)}-${h.slice(8, 12)}-${h.slice(12, 16)}-${h.slice(16, 20)}-${h.slice(20, 32)}`;
72: }
73: 
74: /**
75:  * 从 storage.json 对象抽取 telemetry 作为 devices。
76:  * 无 telemetry 时用 userId/随机数生成独立指纹。
77:  */
78: function devicesFromStorage(storage, seed) {
79:   const machineId = storage && storage['telemetry.machineId'];
80:   const sqmId = storage && storage['telemetry.sqmId'];
81:   const devDeviceId = storage && storage['telemetry.devDeviceId'];
82:   if (machineId || devDeviceId) {
83:     const fallback = genDevices(seed);
84:     return {
85:       machineId: machineId || fallback.machineId,
86:       sqmId: sqmId || null,
87:       devDeviceId: devDeviceId || fallback.devDeviceId,
88:       deviceId: machineId ? (hashDeviceId(machineId) || fallback.deviceId) : fallback.deviceId,
89:       deviceModel: process.env.TRAE_DEVICE_MODEL || '82RF',
90:       osName: process.env.TRAE_OS_NAME || 'windows',
91:       osVersion: process.env.TRAE_OS_VERSION || 'Windows 10',
92:       cpu: process.env.TRAE_CPU || 'Intel',
93:     };
94:   }
95:   return genDevices(seed);
96: }
97: 
98: /** 兼容 authObject 里可能自带的 devices。 */
99: function normalizeDevices(devices) {
100:   if (!devices || typeof devices !== 'object') return null;
101:   const machineId = devices.machineId || devices.machine_id || null;
102:   const devDeviceId = devices.devDeviceId || devices.dev_device_id || devices.deviceId || devices.device_id || null;
103:   if (!machineId && !devDeviceId) return null;
104:   return {
105:     machineId: machineId || genDevices(devDeviceId).machineId,
106:     sqmId: devices.sqmId || devices.sqm_id || null,
107:     devDeviceId: devDeviceId || genDevices(machineId).devDeviceId,
108:     // deviceId 缺失时按 machineId 推导，保证与登录面/签到面的 x-device-id 同源
109:     deviceId: devices.deviceId || devices.device_id || hashDeviceId(machineId || genDevices(devDeviceId).machineId),
110:     deviceModel: devices.deviceModel || devices.device_model || process.env.TRAE_DEVICE_MODEL || '82RF',
111:     osName: devices.osName || devices.os_name || process.env.TRAE_OS_NAME || 'windows',
112:     osVersion: devices.osVersion || devices.os_version || process.env.TRAE_OS_VERSION || 'Windows 10',
113:     cpu: devices.cpu || process.env.TRAE_CPU || 'Intel',
114:   };
115: }
116: 
117: /** 统一的账号结构映射：外部字段 → store 字段。 */
118: function toAccount(auth, extra = {}) {
119:   const labelSrc = extra.label || auth.account || auth.userId;
120:   const account = {
121:     label: typeof labelSrc === 'object' && labelSrc != null ? JSON.stringify(labelSrc) : (labelSrc || 'imported account'),
122:     edition: String(extra.edition || auth.opera_user_region || 'cn').toLowerCase(),
123:     token: auth.token || null,
124:     refreshToken: auth.refreshToken || auth.refresh_token || null,
125:     expiredAt: auth.expiredAt || auth.expire_time || null,
126:     refreshExpiredAt: auth.refreshExpiredAt || auth.refresh_expire_time || null,
127:     tokenReleaseAt: auth.tokenReleaseAt || auth.token_release_time || null,
128:     userId: auth.userId || auth.user_id || auth.account || null,
129:     host: auth.host || null,
130:     userRegion: extra.userRegion || auth.userRegion || null,
131:     devices: extra.devices || null,
132:     group: extra.group != null && extra.group !== '' ? String(extra.group) : (auth.group || null),
133:     // OAuth 账号记住自己的 ClientID/authHost（refreshToken 必须用同一 ClientID 换新）
134:     authClientId: extra.authClientId || auth.authClientId || null,
135:     authHost: extra.authHost || auth.authHost || null,
136:   };
137:   return account;
138: }
139: 
140: /** 按 userId 查已有账号（列表脱敏够用；命中后再 get 全量）。 */
141: function findAccountByUserId(userId) {
142:   if (userId == null || userId === '') return null;
143:   const key = String(userId);
144:   const hit = store.list().find((a) => a.userId != null && String(a.userId) === key);
145:   return hit ? store.get(hit.id) : null;
146: }
147: 
148: /**
149:  * 账号缺少 devices 时生成并写入数据库（已有账号回填）。
150:  * @returns {object|null} 更新后的脱敏账号；已有 devices 则返回 null
151:  */
152: function ensureAccountDevices(accountId) {
153:   const acct = store.get(accountId);
154:   if (!acct) return null;
155:   const normalized = normalizeDevices(acct.devices);
156:   if (normalized && normalized.machineId && normalized.devDeviceId) {
157:     return null;
158:   }
159:   const seed = acct.userId || acct.id;
160:   const devices = genDevices(seed);
161:   const updated = store.update(acct.id, { devices });
162:   console.log(`[import] backfilled devices for account ${acct.id}`);
163:   return updated;
164: }
165: 
166: /**
167:  * 遍历账号，为 devices 缺失者回填。
168:  *
169:  * 按平台分流：ZCode 账号的设备身份是 accounts.fingerprint（成套桌面 SKU +
170:  * device_mid，见 zcode/fingerprint.js），不适用 Trae 的 machineId/devDeviceId
171:  * 两件套，给它填 Trae devices 没有意义且会被误当作 Trae 账号。
172:  */
173: function ensureAllMissingDevices() {
174:   const list = store.list();
175:   const variant = require('../platform/variant');
176:   let filled = 0;
177:   let filledZcode = 0;
178:   for (const a of list) {
179:     const full = store.get(a.id);
180:     if (!full) continue;
181:     if (variant.isEdition(full.edition, variant.ZCODE)) {
182:       // ZCode：缺 fingerprint 时分配一套成套桌面档案
183:       if (require('../zcode/fingerprint').validate(full.fingerprint)) {
184:         require('../zcode/fingerprint').profileFor(full, (fp) => {
185:           store.update(full.id, { fingerprint: fp });
186:         });
187:         filled += 1;
188:         filledZcode += 1;
189:       }
190:       continue;
191:     }
192:     const n = normalizeDevices(full.devices);
193:     if (n && n.machineId && n.devDeviceId) continue;
194:     ensureAccountDevices(a.id);
195:     filled += 1;
196:   }
197:   return { total: list.length, filled, filledZcode };
198: }
199: 
200: /**
201:  * 重复导入时的设备指纹取舍：原账号已有完整指纹则保留（身份稳定优先），
202:  * 否则用本次导入的指纹补齐。storage.json 导入带真实 telemetry，视为可信更新。
203:  */
204: function keepExistingDevices(existingDevices, incomingDevices) {
205:   const cur = normalizeDevices(existingDevices);
206:   const inc = normalizeDevices(incomingDevices);
207:   if (cur && cur.machineId && cur.devDeviceId) return cur;
208:   return inc || cur;
209: }
210: 
211: /**
212:  * 导入账号凭据。
213:  * @param {object} input { storageJsonText?, authObject?, refreshToken?, label?, devices?, edition?, forceNew? }
214:  * @returns {object} 已入库账号（脱敏）；重复 userId 且非 forceNew 时更新凭据并带 action:'updated'
215:  */
216: function importAccount(input = {}) {
217:   let auth = null;
218:   let storageDevices = null;
219: 
220:   if (input.authObject) {
221:     auth = input.authObject;
222:     storageDevices = normalizeDevices(input.devices) || normalizeDevices(input.authObject.devices);
223:   } else if (input.refreshToken) {
224:     auth = { refreshToken: input.refreshToken, label: input.label };
225:     storageDevices = normalizeDevices(input.devices);
226:   } else if (input.storageJsonText) {
227:     const storage = parseStorageJson(input.storageJsonText);
228:     auth = authFromStorageJson(input.storageJsonText);
229:     const seed = auth.userId || auth.account || input.label || Date.now();
230:     storageDevices = normalizeDevices(input.devices) || devicesFromStorage(storage, seed);
231:   } else {
232:     throw new Error('Provide one of: storageJsonText, authObject, refreshToken');
233:   }
234: 
235:   if (!hasCredibleToken(auth)) {
236:     throw new Error('imported credential has neither token nor refreshToken');
237:   }
238: 
239:   // 任何导入路径最终都保证有独立设备指纹；OAuth 登录传入的 pending.device（input.devices）
240:   // 优先于随机生成，使登录面与 API 面使用同一设备身份。
241:   const devices = storageDevices || genDevices(auth.userId || input.label || Date.now());
242: 
243:   const account = toAccount(auth, {
244:     label: input.label,
245:     edition: input.edition,
246:     userRegion: auth.export_region || input.userRegion,
247:     devices,
248:     authClientId: input.authClientId,
249:     authHost: input.authHost,
250:   });
251: 
252:   if (!input.forceNew && account.userId != null && account.userId !== '') {
253:     const existing = findAccountByUserId(account.userId);
254:     if (existing) {
255:       const patch = {
256:         label: input.label || existing.label,
257:         edition: account.edition || existing.edition,
258:         host: account.host || existing.host,
259:         userRegion: account.userRegion || existing.userRegion,
260:         // 保留既有稳定指纹优先：同账号反复登录不应漂移设备身份（设备维度风控的典型信号）。
261:         // 仅当原账号缺指纹或本次导入带全新指纹（storage.json 来源）时才更新。
262:         devices: keepExistingDevices(existing.devices, account.devices),
263:         lastCheckinResult: 'import_updated',
264:       };
265:       if (account.token) patch.token = account.token;
266:       if (account.refreshToken) patch.refreshToken = account.refreshToken;
267:       if (account.expiredAt) patch.expiredAt = account.expiredAt;
268:       if (account.refreshExpiredAt) patch.refreshExpiredAt = account.refreshExpiredAt;
269:       if (account.tokenReleaseAt) patch.tokenReleaseAt = account.tokenReleaseAt;
270:       // OAuth 来源的凭据必须记住自己的 ClientID/authHost（refreshToken 与 ClientID 绑定）
271:       if (account.authClientId) patch.authClientId = account.authClientId;
272:       if (account.authHost) patch.authHost = account.authHost;
273:       const updated = store.update(existing.id, patch);
274:       updated.action = 'updated';
275:       updated.replacedId = existing.id;
276:       return updated;
277:     }
278:   }
279: 
280:   const created = store.add(account, 'import');
281:   created.action = 'created';
282:   return created;
283: }
284: 
285: /**
286:  * 批量导入。逐条失败不中断；同 userId 更新而非重复插入。
287:  * @returns {ok, updated, failed}
288:  */
289: function importMany(items) {
290:   const ok = [];
291:   const updated = [];
292:   const failed = [];
293:   for (const item of items) {
294:     try {
295:       const r = importAccount(item);
296:       if (r.action === 'updated') updated.push(r);
297:       else ok.push(r);
298:     } catch (e) {
299:       failed.push({ reason: e.message, input: pick(item, ['label', 'storageJsonText']) });
300:     }
301:   }
302:   return { ok, updated, failed };
303: }
304:

1: # ZCode 运营面接入说明（限时套餐自动探测与领取）
2: 
3: > 接入范围：**仅账号运营面**——本机凭据导入、限时套餐（赠送额度）探测与领取、额度查询、定时任务。
4: > **不含对话转发**：ZCode 的 messages 通道按设备指纹+追踪头识别客户端，头形态写错会触发上游 3012
5: > 「unusual activity」真风控。在未充分验证前刻意不并入转发池（`capability.chat=false`）。
6: 
7: ## 它解决什么
8: 
9: ZCode 客户端会不定期下发「限时领取」的赠送套餐（如 `ZCode Trust Build`：GLM-5.3-Flash ×1 亿 tokens，
10: 一次性或按日发放）。官方只在客户端里弹横幅，关闭就错过。本模块在 RelayGate 内定时探测并自动领取：
11: 
12: - 每日 **00:30** 与 **21:30**（本地时区）各探测一轮
13: - 有可领套餐 → 自动解验证码 → 自动 claim → 通知
14: - 已领取过（上游 1003）幂等跳过，不会重复请求
15: - 触发风控（3012）立即中止该账号并单独告警
16: 
17: ## 上游链路（实证）
18: 
19: ```
20: POST https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/event/report           ← app_launch + app_daily_active（无鉴权）
21: GET  https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/zcode-plan/billing/preview?app_version=   ← 可领套餐列表
22: POST https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/zcode-plan/billing/claim  {"plan_id"}    ← 领取（需验证码）
23: GET  https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/zcode-plan/billing/balance?app_version=   ← 额度
24: GET  https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/client/configs?app_version=               ← 验证码 scene 配置
25: ```
26: 
27: 业务码语义（`platform/variant.js` → `errors`）：
28: 
29: | code | 含义 | 处理 |
30: |---|---|---|
31: | 0 | 成功 | 落库 + 通知 |
32: | 1001 | 套餐不存在或已下架 | 失败 |
33: | 1002 | 活动结束 | 失败 |
34: | 1003 | 已领取过 | **幂等成功**（already） |
35: | 1004 | 不符合条件 | 失败 |
36: | 1005 | 今日名额用完 | 失败 |
37: | 3001 | 参数错误 | 失败（通常是头不全） |
38: | 3007 | 验证码校验失败 | **换码重试一次** |
39: | 3012 | 真风控 unusual activity | **中止该账号 + 告警** |
40: 
41: 关键实测结论（写代码时勿凭直觉改）：
42: 
43: 1. `billing/preview` **必须带全套客户端身份头**（`X-ZCode-App-Version` / `X-Platform` / `X-Device-Mid` …），
44:    裸请求直接 `3001 parameter error`。
45: 2. `client/configs` **禁止带 `platform` 参数**，带则 `3001`。
46: 3. `billing/claim` 的 `X-Platform` 是 `<platform>-<arch>` 形态（如 `win32-x64`），缺版本/平台头即使
47:    验证码有效也 `3007`。
48: 4. 验证码参数（`certifyId`）**一次性**，复用会被官方客户端同款 F008 重复提交检测拒绝；每次 claim 现解。
49: 5. 激活事件上报（app_launch/app_daily_active）是活动投放资格的疑似信号——官方客户端可见活动但
50:    preview 为空的不符点，多与漏报日活相关。探测前先上报，失败不阻断。
51: 
52: ## 快速开始
53: 
54: ### 1. 导入本机账号
55: 
56: 前提：本机装有 ZCode 桌面客户端且登录过（凭据文件 `~/.zcode/v2/credentials.json`）。
57: 
58: ```powershell
59: # 方式 A：调用 API（管理密钥鉴权）
60: POST /v1/zcode/local/import
61: 
62: # 方式 B：命令行脚本
63: node scripts/zcode-import-local.js
64: ```
65: 
66: 导入内容：`zcodejwttoken`（列级 AES-256-GCM 加密入库）、`user_id`、设备档案。
67: 客户端的 JWT 无 `exp` 字段、也不返回 refresh_token，**长期有效，无需保活**。
68: 
69: > 凭据解密密钥派生自客户端 asar 实现：`sha256("zcode-credential-fallback:<platform>:<homedir>:<username>")`。
70: > 若客户端重装或系统用户名变更导致解密失败，设 `ZCODE_CREDENTIAL_SECRET` 显式指定。
71: 
72: ### 2. 开启定时任务
73: 
74: ```powershell
75: # .env
76: ZCODE_REWARDS_ENABLED=true
77: ```
78: 
79: 或热改：`POST /v1/zcode/settings {"enabled": true}`。
80: 时段可在面板设置或 env 调整（默认 00:30 / 21:30）。
81: 
82: ### 3. 验证
83: 
84: ```powershell
85: # 状态（含求解器可用性）
86: GET /v1/zcode/status
87: 
88: # 手动跑一轮（探测 + 领取）
89: POST /v1/zcode/rewards/run
90: 
91: # 只探测不领取
92: POST /v1/zcode/accounts/<id>/rewards/probe
93: 
94: # 验证码自检（真实求解一次）
95: POST /v1/zcode/diagnose/captcha
96: ```
97: 
98: 结果在面板「任务日志」中查 `task=zcode-rewards`；通知走既有渠道
99: （事件：`zcode_reward_claimed` / `zcode_reward_failed` / `zcode_reward_risk`）。
100: 
101: ## 架构与文件
102: 
103: ```
104: src/platform/variant.js        ZCODE 变体表（域名/路径/业务码/能力位/时段）—— 单一事实源
105: src/zcode/
106:   fingerprint.js               每账号成套桌面设备档案（platform×arch×os×screen 绑定 + device_mid）
107:   identity.js                  billing 面身份头（pio 头集合；顺序与取值对齐官方客户端）
108:   client.js                    HTTP 通道（信封解析 / 业务码错误 / 代理复用）
109:   captcha.js                   阿里云无感验证码求解（子进程调 solver.js）
110:   rewards.js                   激活上报 / preview / claim / balance（业务核心）
111:   local.js                     本机客户端凭据解密导入（AES-256-GCM）
112: src/jobs/zcode-rewards.js      每日 00:30/21:30 定时（错峰 / 幂等 / 任务日志 / 通知）
113: src/routes/zcode.js            /v1/zcode 管理端点
114: scripts/zcode-import-local.js  命令行导入
115: scripts/zcode-e2e.js           端到端演练（真实打上游）
116: ```
117: 
118: ### 与既有系统的关系
119: 
120: - **账号库共用** `accounts` 表，`edition='zcode'` 区分；新增列 `api_key_enc` / `fingerprint` / `mode`
121:   （均可空，旧账号零影响）。
122: - **转发池隔离**：`pool.editionOk` 走 `variant.canChat` 能力位，zcode 账号不可能被 Trae/WorkBuddy
123:   请求选中；签到链、token 保活、账单扫描同样按能力位/白名单显式排除 zcode。
124: - **余额刷新**：`upstream/balance.js` 已分流——zcode 账号走自己的 `billing/balance`
125:   （token 计量），面板余额列显示剩余 token 数。
126: 
127: ### 验证码求解器
128: 
129: `billing/claim` 强制阿里云无感验证码。求解器复用 `zcode2api/captcha_node/solver.js`
130: （Node + happy-dom 模拟浏览器，无真实浏览器依赖），通过 `ZCODE_CAPTCHA_SOLVER_DIR` 指向：
131: 
132: ```
133: 默认：C:\opt\workstations\project\zcode2api\captcha_node
134: 首次：在该目录 npm install（本机已装好）
135: ```
136: 
137: 实测单次求解 2–8 秒，成功率约 2/3（阿里云 pe 字节码 VM 偶发 stall），代码内置 3 次重试，
138: 重试后仍失败记 `failed` 并在下轮重试——对每日两轮的节奏完全够用。
139: 
140: ## 配置项
141: 
142: | env | 默认 | 说明 |
143: |---|---|---|
144: | `ZCODE_REWARDS_ENABLED` | `false` | 定时任务总开关（默认关，避免影响现有池） |
145: | `ZCODE_REWARD_HOUR_1` / `_MINUTE_1` | `0` / `30` | 第一探测时段 |
146: | `ZCODE_REWARD_HOUR_2` / `_MINUTE_2` | `21` / `30` | 第二探测时段 |
147: | `ZCODE_REWARD_SPREAD_MINUTES` | `10` | 多账号错峰窗口（单账号无影响） |
148: | `ZCODE_REWARD_AUTO_CLAIM` | `true` | 关闭则只探测通知、不实际领取 |
149: | `ZCODE_APP_VERSION` | `3.14.4` | 客户端版本头 |
150: | `ZCODE_TIMEOUT_MS` | `25000` | 上游超时 |
151: | `ZCODE_CAPTCHA_SOLVER_DIR` | zcode2api 路径 | 求解器目录 |
152: | `ZCODE_NODE_PATH` | `node` | Node 可执行文件 |
153: | `ZCODE_CAPTCHA_RETRIES` | `3` | 单次领取的求解重试次数 |
154: | `ZCODE_CREDENTIAL_SECRET` | 派生 | 客户端凭据解密密钥（一般不用设） |
155: 
156: 时段/开关也可在 `.trae-api/zcode-settings.json` 热改（文件 > env > 默认）。
157: 
158: ## 计量口径隔离（关键约束，改代码前必读）
159: 
160: ZCode 的额度单位是 **token**（单包量级 1e8），而 RelayGate 既有「积分」体系
161: （balance 列 / entitlement_snapshot.packs / credit_history，单位 credit，量级 1e3）
162: 是两套完全不同的计量。**禁止把 token 数写进任何积分口径**，否则：
163: 
164: - 面板「可用额度 / 今日消耗」被抬高约 4 个数量级（实测单账号 86,560,855 tokens
165:   混进 ~5,400 credits 的日消耗，`totalUsed` 从 5,437 变 902,822,370）；
166: - 「3 日内到期积分」同样被污染；
167: - pool 的 FEFO 排序、`MIN_BALANCE_TO_USE` 过滤、低余额告警读到的是 token 数。
168: 
169: 约定（当前实现已遵守）：
170: 
171: | 位置 | ZCode 写入 | 积分消费方 |
172: |---|---|---|
173: | `accounts.balance` | 恒 `null` | pool / credit-alerts / 面板余额列 |
174: | `entitlement_snapshot.packs` | **不写** | `creditTotals` / `summarizeExpiry` / `summarizeFefo` / FEFO 排序 |
175: | `entitlement_snapshot.tokenBuckets` | ✔ 写（token 桶 + `tokenRemaining`） | 无积分消费方 |
176: | `credit_history` | **不写** | `/v1/admin/credit-history` 的 `totalUsed` |
177: 
178: 前端展示：CredentialsPage / OverviewPage 对 ZCode 账号显示 `tokenRemaining` 并标注
179: `tok` 单位，不并入积分。
180: 
181: - 历史污染修复：`node scripts/zcode-fix-credit-pollution.js --apply`（先不带参数预览）
182: - 回归验证：`node scripts/zcode-verify-credit-isolation.js`
183: - 影响面盘点：`node scripts/zcode-credit-impact.js`
184: 
185: ---
186: 
187: ## 风险与边界
188: 
189: - **只自动领取本机已登录账号自己的活动奖励**，不做多账号批量刷活动——那属于风控对象。
190: - 高频调用 `billing/claim` 会触发 429；定时任务每日两轮 + 1003 幂等跳过，天然保守。
191: - `3012` 视为真风控：立即中止该账号本轮并告警，**不会**自动换指纹重试（换设备是人工决策，
192:   走 `POST /v1/zcode/accounts/:id/fingerprint/rotate`）。
193: - 验证码 `certifyId` 一次性，绝不复用。
194: - 转发面（messages 通道）未启用；接入前需独立账号验证头形态，相关字段已预留在
195:   `variant.paths.messages`。

(End of file - total 195 lines)
