77: /** 解析 preview 的套餐项（只保留 token 计量口径的授权项）。 */
78: function parsePlan(raw) {
79:   if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return null;
80:   const planId = String(raw.plan_id || raw.planId || '').trim();
81:   if (!planId) return null;
82:   const grants = [];
83:   for (const ent of Array.isArray(raw.entitlements) ? raw.entitlements : []) {
84:     if (!ent || typeof ent !== 'object') continue;
85:     if (ent.meter !== 'model_usage' || ent.unit_type !== 'token') continue;
86:     const name = String(ent.show_name || ent.showName || '').trim();
87:     if (!name) continue;
88:     grants.push({
89:       name,
90:       units: Number(ent.grant_units || ent.grantUnits || 0) || 0,
91:       period: String(ent.period || 'one_time'),
92:       capabilities: Array.isArray(ent.capabilities) ? ent.capabilities : [],
93:     });
94:   }
95:   return {
96:     planId,
97:     name: String(raw.name || '').trim(),
98:     description: String(raw.description || '').trim(),
99:     priority: Number(raw.priority) || 0,
100:     grants,
101:   };
102: }

104: /**
105:  * 上报激活事件（官方客户端启动/日活）。
106:  * 失败只记录，不阻断——它只是疑似资格信号，且日活键在上游按
107:  * device_mid + 日期去重，重试无意义。
108:  * @returns {Promise<{ok:string[], failed:string[]}>}
109:  */
110: async function reportActivation(acct) {
111:   const fp = fingerprint.profileFor(acct, (fresh) => {
112:     try { store.update(acct.id, { fingerprint: fresh }); } catch { /* 账号库写入失败不阻断 */ }
113:   });
114:   const userId = jwtUserId(acct.token);
115:   const result = { ok: [], failed: [] };
116:   if (!userId) {
117:     result.failed.push('JWT 无 user_id，跳过激活上报');
118:     return result;
119:   }
120:   for (const element of V.activationElements) {
121:     const body = buildActivationEvent(element, fp, userId);
122:     try {
123:       // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
124:       const envelope = await request({
125:         method: 'POST',
126:         path: V.paths.eventReport,
127:         headers: identity.eventHeaders(),
128:         body,
129:         timeoutMs: 10000,
130:       });
131:       if (envelope && Number(envelope.code) === 0) result.ok.push(element);
132:       else result.failed.push(`${element}: code=${envelope && envelope.code}`);
133:     } catch (e) {
134:       result.failed.push(`${element}: ${e.message}`);
135:     }
136:   }
137:   return result;
138: }

140: /** 官方 sendReport 的 16 字段事件体（字段集固定，不可增删）。 */
141: function buildActivationEvent(element, fp, userId) {
142:   const crypto = require('crypto');
143:   return {
144:     event_id: crypto.randomUUID(),
145:     client_timezone: fp.timezone,
146:     client_language: fp.language,
147:     element_name: element,
148:     event_region: 'app',
149:     event_type: 'view',
150:     event_text: '',
151:     event_extra_detail: {},
152:     user_id: userId,
153:     screen_resolution: fp.screen,
154:     app_version: identity.appVersion(),
155:     device_os_category: fingerprint.osCategory(fp),
156:     device_os_version: fp.osVersion,
157:     device_mid: fp.deviceMid,
158:     mac_id: '',
159:     marketing_params: '{}',
160:   };
161: }

163: /** 从 JWT 解出 user_id（缺失时回退 sub）；不校验签名（只读取自己存的凭据）。 */
164: function jwtUserId(token) {
165:   const t = String(token || '').trim();
166:   if (!t) return null;
167:   const seg = t.split('.')[1];
168:   if (!seg) return null;
169:   try {
170:     const payload = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(seg, 'base64url').toString('utf-8'));
171:     const uid = payload.user_id || payload.sub;
172:     return uid != null && String(uid).trim() ? String(uid).trim() : null;
173:   } catch {
174:     return null;
175:   }
176: }

178: /**
179:  * 拉取当前账号可领取的套餐（按优先级降序）。
180:  * @returns {Promise<Array<object>>}
181:  */
182: async function previewPlans(acct) {
183:   const blocked = billingBlockReason(acct, { action: '查询' });
184:   if (blocked) throw new ZCodeApiError(blocked, { code: null });
185:   const envelope = await request({
186:     method: 'GET',
187:     path: V.paths.billingPreview,
188:     headers: buildBillingHeaders(acct),
189:     query: { app_version: identity.appVersion() },
190:   });
191:   const data = unwrap(envelope, { method: 'GET', path: V.paths.billingPreview });
192:   const raw = Array.isArray(data && data.plans) ? data.plans : [];
193:   return raw.map(parsePlan).filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => (b.priority - a.priority) || a.planId.localeCompare(b.planId));
194: }
195: 
196: /** billing 面身份头（含账号指纹与 token）。 */
197: function buildBillingHeaders(acct) {
198:   const fp = fingerprint.profileFor(acct, (fresh) => {
199:     try { store.update(acct.id, { fingerprint: fresh }); } catch { /* 账号库写入失败不阻断 */ }
200:   });
201:   return identity.identityHeaders(fp, { token: acct.token });
202: }
203: 
204: /**
205:  * 查询账号额度（billing/balance）。
206:  * 返回 { plans, balances, serverTime }。
207:  */
208: async function fetchBalance(acct) {
209:   const blocked = billingBlockReason(acct, { action: '查询额度' });
210:   if (blocked) throw new ZCodeApiError(blocked, { code: null });
211:   const envelope = await request({
212:     method: 'GET',
213:     path: V.paths.billingBalance,
214:     headers: buildBillingHeaders(acct),
215:     query: { app_version: identity.appVersion() },
216:   });
217:   const data = unwrap(envelope, { method: 'GET', path: V.paths.billingBalance }) || {};
218:   return {
219:     plans: Array.isArray(data.plans) ? data.plans : [],
220:     balances: Array.isArray(data.balances) ? data.balances : [],
221:     serverTime: data.server_time,
222:   };
223: }
224: 
225: /**
226:  * 领取指定套餐（或自动选优先级最高的）。
227:  *
228:  * 验证码策略：3007 换码重试一次（参数一次性且可能被风控拒绝）。
229:  * 幂等：1003「已领取过」按 already 返回，不视为失败。
230:  *
231:  * @param {object} acct
232:  * @param {string} [planId]
233:  * @param {{maxCaptchaRetries?:number}} [opts]
234:  * @returns {Promise<{result:string, planId:string, planName:string, grants:Array, message:string, code:number|null}>}
235:  */
236: async function claimPlan(acct, planId, opts = {}) {
237:   const blocked = billingBlockReason(acct, { action: '领取' });
238:   if (blocked) throw new ZCodeApiError(blocked, { code: null });
239: 
240:   let target = String(planId || '').trim();
241:   let planName = '';
242:   let grants = [];
243:   if (!target) {
244:     const plans = await previewPlans(acct);
245:     if (!plans.length) {
246:       return {
247:         result: CLAIM_RESULT.FAILED, planId: '', planName: '', grants: [],
248:         message: '当前没有可领取的套餐', code: null,
249:       };
250:     }
251:     target = plans[0].planId;
252:     planName = plans[0].name || plans[0].planId;
253:     grants = plans[0].grants;
254:   }
255: 
256:   const maxRetries = Math.max(1, Number(opts.maxCaptchaRetries || 2));
257:   let lastCode = null;
258:   let lastMsg = '';
259: 
260:   for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
261:     // 验证码每次现解：certifyId 一次性，复用必被拒（F008 重复提交检测）
262:     let verify;
263:     try {
264:       // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
265:       verify = await captcha.getVerifyParam();
266:     } catch (e) {
267:       if (e instanceof captcha.CaptchaUnavailableError) {
268:         return {
269:           result: CLAIM_RESULT.FAILED, planId: target, planName, grants,
270:           message: `验证码不可用：${e.message}`, code: null,
271:         };
272:       }
273:       return {
274:         result: CLAIM_RESULT.FAILED, planId: target, planName, grants,
275:         message: e.message, code: null,
276:       };
277:     }
278: 
279:     const headers = {
280:       ...buildBillingHeaders(acct),
281:       ...captcha.claimHeaders(verify.param, verify.region),
282:     };
283: 
284:     let envelope;
285:     try {
286:       // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
287:       envelope = await request({
288:         method: 'POST',
289:         path: V.paths.billingClaim,
290:         headers,
291:         body: { plan_id: target },
292:       });
293:     } catch (e) {
294:       if (e instanceof ZCodeApiError) {
295:         lastCode = e.code;
296:         lastMsg = e.message;
297:       } else {
298:         return {
299:           result: CLAIM_RESULT.FAILED, planId: target, planName, grants,
300:           message: e.message, code: null,
301:         };
302:       }
303:       break;
304:     }
305: 
306:     const code = Number(envelope && envelope.code);
307:     const msg = String((envelope && (envelope.msg || envelope.message)) || '').trim();
308: 
309:     if (code === 0) {
310:       const plan = (envelope.data && envelope.data.plan) || {};
311:       return {
312:         result: CLAIM_RESULT.CLAIMED,
313:         planId: String(plan.plan_id || target),
314:         planName: planName || String(plan.name || target),
315:         grants,
316:         message: msg || '领取成功',
317:         code: 0,
318:         plan,
319:       };
320:     }
321:     if (code === ERR.alreadyClaimed) {
322:       return {
323:         result: CLAIM_RESULT.ALREADY, planId: target, planName, grants,
324:         message: failText(code, msg), code,
325:       };
326:     }
327:     if (code === ERR.riskControl) {
328:       return {
329:         result: CLAIM_RESULT.RISK, planId: target, planName, grants,
330:         message: failText(code, msg), code,
331:       };
332:     }
333:     lastCode = code;
334:     lastMsg = msg;
335:     if (code === ERR.captchaFailed && attempt < maxRetries) {
336:       console.warn(`[zcode-rewards] 账号 ${acct.label || acct.id} 验证码被拒，换码重试`);
337:       continue;
338:     }
339:     break;
340:   }
341: 
342:   return {
343:     result: CLAIM_RESULT.FAILED, planId: target, planName, grants,
344:     message: failText(lastCode, lastMsg), code: lastCode,
345:   };
346: }
347: 
348: /**
349:  * 探测（不领取）：上报激活 → preview。
350:  * 这是定时任务的主路径，也是「只查不领」模式的实现。
351:  *
352:  * @param {object} acct
353:  * @param {{activation?:boolean}} [opts]
354:  * @returns {Promise<{accountId:string, label:string, plans:Array, activation:object|null, error:string|null}>}
355:  */
356: async function probe(acct, opts = {}) {
357:   const out = {
358:     accountId: acct.id,
359:     label: acct.label || acct.id,
360:     plans: [],
361:     activation: null,
362:     error: null,
363:   };
364:   if (opts.activation !== false) {
365:     try {
366:       out.activation = await reportActivation(acct);
367:     } catch (e) {
368:       out.activation = { ok: [], failed: [e.message] };
369:     }
370:   }
371:   try {
372:     out.plans = await previewPlans(acct);
373:   } catch (e) {
374:     out.error = e.message;
375:   }
376:   return out;
377: }
378: 
379: /**
380:  * 对单个账号执行「探测 + 领取全部可领套餐」。
381:  * @param {object} acct
382:  * @param {{claim?:boolean}} [opts] claim=false 时只探测
383:  */
384: async function runForAccount(acct, opts = {}) {
385:   const probed = await probe(acct, opts);
386:   const out = { ...probed, claimed: [], already: [], failed: [], risk: null };
387:   if (opts.claim === false || probed.error || !probed.plans.length) return out;
388: 
389:   for (const plan of probed.plans) {
390:     // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
391:     const r = await claimPlan(acct, plan.planId);
392:     if (r.result === CLAIM_RESULT.CLAIMED) out.claimed.push(r);
393:     else if (r.result === CLAIM_RESULT.ALREADY) out.already.push(r);
394:     else if (r.result === CLAIM_RESULT.RISK) { out.risk = r; break; }
395:     else out.failed.push(r);
396:     // 账号内多套餐间保底间隔：避免同刻连击上游
397:     // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
398:     await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 1500));
399:   }
400:   return out;
401: }
402: 
403: module.exports = {
404:   CLAIM_RESULT,
405:   CLAIM_FAIL_TEXT,
406:   isZcode,
407:   billingBlockReason,
408:   parsePlan,
409:   jwtUserId,
410:   buildActivationEvent,
411:   reportActivation,
412:   previewPlans,
413:   fetchBalance,
414:   claimPlan,
415:   probe,
416:   runForAccount,
417: };

1: 'use strict';
2: /**
3:  * upstream/checkin-all.js — 跨平台「全部签到」聚合（m-39）。
4:  *
5:  * 此前前端「全部签到」指向 Trae 专用的 POST /v1/credentials/checkin，该端点
6:  * 内部按 `variant.isTrae(a.edition)` 过滤，WorkBuddy 账号被静默跳过；而
7:  * WorkBuddy 自己的批量端点 /v1/workbuddy/checkin-all 前端从未调用。按钮名
8:  * 承诺「全部」，实际只签 Trae，且跳过无任何提示。
9:  *
10:  * 本模块是平台无关的聚合层：以 platform/variant 的 capability.checkin 为准
11:  * 枚举平台，逐平台调用各自实现，返回分平台明细。不放入 upstream/checkin.js
12:  * ——那是 Trae 签到实现，混入 WorkBuddy 会让它同时依赖两个平台模块。
13:  */
14: const store = require('../credentials/store');
15: const variant = require('../platform/variant');
16: const { appendCheckinTaskLog } = require('../jobs/checkin-log');
17: 
18: /** 单平台的签到实现（惰性 require：避免本模块与具体平台实现产生顶层依赖）。 */
19: const PLATFORM_RUNNERS = {
20:   trae: () => require('./checkin').checkinAllEnabled,
21:   workbuddy: () => require('./wb-checkin').wbCheckinAllEnabled,
22: };
23: 
24: /** 把某个平台的批次结果压成统一的明细行。 */
25: function summarize(platformId, batch, err) {
26:   if (err) {
27:     return {
28:       platform: platformId,
29:       total: 0,
30:       claimed: 0,
31:       already: 0,
32:       disabled: 0,
33:       failed: 1,
34:       error: err.message,
35:       accounts: [],
36:     };
37:   }
38:   const accounts = [
39:     ...(batch.claimed || []).map((x) => ({ id: x.accountId || x.id, label: x.label, result: 'claimed', credit: x.checkinCredits ?? null })),
40:     ...(batch.already || []).map((x) => ({ id: x.accountId || x.id, label: x.label, result: 'already' })),
41:     ...(batch.disabled || []).map((x) => ({ id: x.accountId || x.id, label: x.label, result: 'disabled' })),
42:     ...(batch.failed || []).map((x) => ({ id: x.accountId || x.id, label: x.label, result: 'failed', reason: x.reason || null })),
43:   ];
44:   return {
45:     platform: platformId,
46:     total: batch.total != null ? batch.total : accounts.length,
47:     claimed: (batch.claimed || []).length,
48:     already: (batch.already || []).length,
49:     disabled: (batch.disabled || []).length,
50:     failed: (batch.failed || []).length,
51:     error: null,
52:     accounts,
53:   };
54: }
55: 
56: /**
57:  * 本轮实际参与签到的平台：由启用账号的 edition 推导，而非硬编码平台名单。
58:  * 新增平台只要在 variant 里声明 capability.checkin 并有对应 runner，就会
59:  * 自动纳入「全部签到」；没有账号的平台也不会白跑一轮。
60:  *
61:  * edition 归一：Trae 侧历史值（cn/sg/us/manual）必须归到 trae，否则 cn 账号
62:  * 会因查不到 runner 被丢弃（首次实测只跑了 workbuddy，正是漏了这步）。
63:  */
64: function checkinPlatforms() {
65:   const ids = new Set();
66:   for (const a of store.list()) {
67:     if (!a.enabled) continue;
68:     const id = variant.normalizeEdition(a.edition);
69:     if (!variant.can(id, 'checkin')) continue;
70:     if (PLATFORM_RUNNERS[id]) ids.add(id);
71:   }
72:   // 稳定顺序：trae 在前（历史行为），其余按字典序
73:   const order = ['trae', 'workbuddy'];
74:   return [...ids].sort((a, b) => {
75:     const ia = order.indexOf(a); const ib = order.indexOf(b);
76:     if (ia !== -1 && ib !== -1) return ia - ib;
77:     if (ia !== -1) return -1;
78:     if (ib !== -1) return 1;
79:     return a.localeCompare(b);
80:   });
81: }

83: /**
84:  * 对所有「声明了签到能力」的平台跑一遍批量签到。
85:  *
86:  * @param {{spreadMinutes?:number, windowStartMs?:number, trigger?:string, notifyOnDone?:boolean}} [opts]
87:  *   trigger      'manual'（默认）或 'scheduler'，仅用于任务日志与通知措辞
88:  *   notifyOnDone 是否推送汇总通知（手动触发时用户明确要求提醒，见 m-39）
89:  * @returns {Promise<object>} {object, trigger, total, claimed, already, disabled, failed, platforms[], message}
90:  */
91: async function checkinAllByPlatform(opts = {}) {
92:   const spreadMinutes = Number(opts.spreadMinutes) || 0;
93:   const windowStartMs = opts.windowStartMs || Date.now();
94:   const trigger = opts.trigger || 'manual';
95:   const notifyOnDone = opts.notifyOnDone !== false;
96: 
97:   // 统计本轮实际会签到多少账号（含各平台），避免「点了但一个号都没有」的假成功
98:   const accounts = store.list().filter((a) => a.enabled && variant.can(a.edition, 'checkin'));
99:   const platforms = checkinPlatforms();
100: 
101:   const results = [];

tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- **Original (verbatim):** "分析新的接入任务，`C:\opt\workstations\agents\Qoder`，Qcoder 每日10点后可领取100积分，有效期三十日，并且客户端内，Qwen3.8-Flash限免。研究如何在本项目接入Qoder。"
- **Evolving (verbatim):** User supplied 6 GitHub repos and asked "结合上述项目，以及本项目的经验，重新评估分析"; then "现在结合方案，分析国际版和国内版的区别，并实际解包验证，国内版现在还没有签到，你可以尝试签到测试。" with `C:\opt\workstations\agents\Qoder CN`
- **Latest (verbatim):** "开始实施。" — Begin implementation of the P1/P2/P3 plan.
- Deliverable: analysis docs in `docs/` + actual code in `src/qoder/` following the ZCode precedent.

## Key Technical Concepts
- **RelayGate**: multi-platform account-pool gateway; Node.js CommonJS `'use strict'`, Express, `node:sqlite` `DatabaseSync`, AES-256-GCM column encryption.
- **`platform/variant.js`**: single source of truth (`VARIANTS[TRAE|WORKBUDDY|ZCODE]`); new platform = add `VARIANTS[QODER]` with `capability` flags, `hosts`, `identity`, `paths`, `errors`.
- **Capability-driven dispatch**: `can(edition,'checkin')`, `canChat`, `isEdition`, `hostFor`, `regionOf`, `clientAuthDir`.
- **ZCode precedent** (`src/zcode/`): `local.js` (credential import), `client.js` (HTTP channel + envelope unwrap), `identity.js`, `fingerprint.js`, `captcha.js`, `rewards.js` + `jobs/zcode-rewards.js` + `routes/zcode.js`. `capability.chat=false` deliberately.
- **Qoder dual-realm credential**: Chromium/Electron `os_crypt` v10 — `auth.v1.dat` = `"v10"` + nonce(12) + AES-256-GCM(ct+tag); key from sibling `Local State` → `os_crypt.encrypted_key` (base64) → strip `"DPAPI"` 5-byte prefix → DPAPI `CryptUnprotectData` → 32-byte key.
- **DPAPI from Node**: no native binding; shell out to `powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command` using `[System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData]::Unprotect`, passing base64 via **stdin** (`[Console]::In.ReadToEnd()`), never as CLI arg.
- **COSY signature (CN legacy protocol)**: `Bearer COSY.<payload_b64>.<sig>` where `sig = md5(payload\ncosyKey\ndate\nbodyEnc\npathStripped)`.
- **`qoder_encode`**: custom Base64 variant — take standard base64, split into tail/middle/head thirds by `a = n//3`, reorder to `std[n-a:] + std[a:n-a] + std[:a]`, then translate through custom alphabet `_doRTgHZBKcGVjlvpC,@aFSx#DPuNJme&i*MzLOEn)sUrthbf%Y^w.(kIQyXqWA!` mapping `=`→`$`.
- **QMC v1 catalog**: `base64(magic "QMC\x01"(4) + nonce(12) + AES-256-GCM)`; key = `HKDF-SHA256(ikm=uid, salt="qoder-model-cache-enc", info="model-cache-v1", 32)`.
- **Store PATCH_COLUMNS**: explicit camelCase→column map in `credentials/store.js`; new columns need entries here.
- **DB migration pattern**: `ensureSchema()` uses `PRAGMA table_info` + conditional `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN`.

## Files and Code
- **`docs/qoder-integration-analysis-v2.md`** (460 lines) — now titled **v3**. Has v3 correction table at top, then v2 content, then **附录 A** (A.1–A.8) covering realm differences. v1 doc (`docs/qoder-integration-analysis.md`) has a deprecation banner pointing to v2.
- **`logs/qoder-realm-diff.md`** — generated machine-readable realm comparison.
- **`scripts/verify-qoder-dual-realm.js`** — decrypts both realms, dumps `endpoint-cache.json`, confirms uid isolation.
- **`scripts/verify-qoder-cn-checkin.js`** — CN campaign query + `--claim` flag for real claim; prints structured benefit summary.
- **`scripts/verify-qoder-cn-idempotent.js`** — double-claims a CLAIMED campaign, asserts credits unchanged.
- **`scripts/verify-qoder-cn-cosy.js`** — **working COSY implementation**. Key excerpt:
  ```js
  const SERVER_PUB_PEM = `-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----
  MIGfMA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBAQUAA4GNADCBiQKBgQDA8iMH5c02LilrsERw9t6Pv5Nc
  4k6Pz1EaDicBMpdpxKduSZu5OANqUq8er4GM95omAGIOPOh+Nx0spthYA2BqGz+l
  6HRkPJ7S236FZz73In/KVuLnwI8JJ2CbuJap8kvheCCZpmAWpb/cPx/3Vr/J6I17
  XcW+ML9FoCI6AOvOzwIDAQAB
  -----END PUBLIC KEY-----`;
  const COSY_VERSION = '1.1.64';
  const USER_TYPE = 'personal_profession_trial';
  // identity 9 keys: name, aid, uid, yx_uid, organization_id,
  //   organization_name, user_type, security_oauth_token, refresh_token
  // payload 5 keys: cosyVersion, ideVersion:"", info, requestId, version:"v1"
  ```
- **`scripts/verify-qoder-catalog-diff.js`** — CN via COSY `model/list`, Intl via QMC decrypt of `catalog-v6`.
- **`scripts/verify-qoder-realm-diff.js`** — generates the full comparison report.
- **`scripts/parse-qoder-cn-asar.js`**, **`extract-qoder-cn-asar.js`**, **`extract-qoder-cn-code.js`** — CN asar tooling (568 JS/JSON files, 61.5MB extracted then deleted).
- **Read during implementation start**: `src/platform/variant.js` (342 lines), `src/zcode/local.js` (151), `src/zcode/client.js` (166), `src/jobs/zcode-rewards.js` (307), `src/credentials/store.js` (336, PATCH_COLUMNS at L60-103), `src/credentials/db.js` (265, migrations at L45-71), `src/zcode/rewards.js` (417).

## Errors and Fixes
- **`{"code":"101","message":"Signature invalid"}`** — root cause was **four** stacked bugs: (a) `cosyVersion` was `"0.4.3"` but must be `"1.1.64"`; (b) `ideVersion` must be `""`; (c) `version` must be `"v1"`; (d) identity had wrong keys (used machine* fields instead of the 9-key set).
- **RSA PEM transcription typo** — I wrote `236FZ73In` but the real line 3 is `236FZz73In` (double `z`). This made `e = 0n`. Node's `createPublicKey` fails on the malformed DER with `error:1E08010C:DECODER routines::unsupported`. Fixed by reading the exact string from `qoder_sign.py:462-467`.
- **`Request with GET/HEAD method cannot have body`** — `fetch` rejects GET+body; the reference uses `urllib.request.Request(url, data=...)` with `method="GET"`. Fixed by switching to `node:https` `request({method:'GET'})` + `req.write(bodyEnc)`.
- **`Request method 'POST' not supported`** — switching to POST was wrong; the endpoint is GET-only. Reverted to GET+body via `node:https`.
- **Python vs JS JSON** — `json.dumps` defaults to `", "`/`": "` separators; `json_sorted_compact` is hand-built compact. Also Python maps `None`→`""`. My `JSON.stringify` matched once keys were correct.
- **QMC magic mismatch** — I checked `magic !== 'QMC1'`; actual bytes are `QMC\x01`. Fixed to check `magic[0..2]===QMC` and `magic[3]===1`.
- **`catalog-v6` read as binary** — the file is **base64 text** (starts `UU1D`). Must `readFileSync(path,'utf8')` then base64-decode.
- **HKDF salt/info wrong** — first tried `salt=∅, info="qmc-v1"`. Correct: `salt="qoder-model-cache-enc"`, `info="model-cache-v1"`.
- **`options.buffer must be ... Received an instance of ArrayBuffer`** — `readFileSync(path, key)` passed the crypto key as the options arg. Fixed to `readFileSync(path)`.
- **PowerShell ParserError** (carried from prior checkpoint) — base64 via stdin, not argv.
- **`fastEndpoint` trap** — Intl's `fastEndpoint` is `api6.qoder.com.cn`, a `.com.cn` host. **Realm cannot be inferred from domain suffix**; must use app/home dir names.

## Pending Jobs
- **Implement P1**: `src/qoder/local.js` — dual-realm credential auto-import (os_crypt v10 + DPAPI), producing store account records.
- **Implement P1 support**: `VARIANTS[QODER]` in `src/platform/variant.js`; `qoder_realm` column in `credentials/db.js` + `PATCH_COLUMNS` entry in `credentials/store.js`.
- **Implement P2**: `src/qoder/rewards.js` (campaigns/quota) + `src/jobs/qoder-rewards.js` (daily 10:00 UTC+8) + `src/routes/qoder.js`.
- **Implement P3**: `src/qoder/catalog.js` — model list sync + `is_free`/`price_factor` (free-model badge).
- **Add qoder branches** in `src/upstream/balance.js`, `src/models/pricing-calib.js:62`, `web/src/features/accounts/CredentialsPage.tsx:523`.
- Optionally clean `/tmp/qoder-repos/` (6 repos, temp dir).

## Current Work
- User said **"开始实施。"** — I created goal `goal-185a5498-1cde-448d-9c5d-f4cc251b30f3` (objective: P1 dual-realm credential import, P2 daily 10:00 auto-claim, P3 catalog sync; follow ZCode precedent and `variant.js` single-source-of-truth).
- Began codebase reconnaissance in parallel: read `variant.js`, `zcode/local.js`, `zcode/client.js`, `jobs/zcode-rewards.js`, `credentials/store.js`, `credentials/db.js`, `zcode/rewards.js`. **No code has been written yet.**

CN check-in **succeeded**: `grantId 01a13473-be68-7a01-a9f5-3c8263e633d2`, `amount 100`, `expiresAt 2026-11-12T08:49:22.99315Z`, `addOnQuota` went from absent → `{total:100,remaining:100}`. Idempotency PASS (same grantId, `replayed:true`, credits stayed 400). COSY `model/list` → HTTP 200, 68155 bytes, 14 models. `machineId 0fbb51733775874877d64abb62ae4068`, `machineType fd1f3ad7791e819cab`, `machineTok ezbdprqMGht-g0YiPZZIw5rvHAojUjaGaMIrnddnBe4`. CN catalog 14 models vs Intl 18; `qfmodel` (Qwen3.8-Flash) `is_free=true, price_factor=0` in **both**; Intl-only: `ultimate/fast/performance/efficient/smodel/cmodel`; CN-only: `q37fmodel/gm51model`; `mmodel` = MiniMax-M3 (Intl) vs M2.7 (CN); CN `qmodel_38max` has off-peak 40% discount 22:00–08:00 UTC+8.
- `npm test` = **14 passed, 0 failed** after all changes.

## Next Step
Write `src/qoder/local.js` — the dual-realm credential importer. Model it on `src/zcode/local.js` (exports `isClientInstalled`, `readLocalCredentials`, `buildAccountFromLocal`), but replace the sha256-secret decryption with the verified os_crypt v10 + DPAPI path: scan both `%APPDATA%\com.qoder.app.stable` and `%APPDATA%\com.qodercn.app.stable`, read `Local State` → `os_crypt.encrypted_key` → DPAPI unwrap via PowerShell stdin → AES-256-GCM decrypt `auth.v1.dat` → emit `{token(dt-), refreshToken(drt-), expiresAt, refreshExpiresAt, user{id,name,email}}` and tag each with its `realm`. This is the foundation for P2/P3.

## Critical Context
- **Realm must be a first-class field** — drives domain choice, protocol choice (new Bearer vs COSY), and catalog fetch method. Do **not** infer realm from hostname (the `api6.qoder.com.cn` trap).
- **Chat forwarding is realm-asymmetric**: Intl `POST api2-v2.qoder.sh/model/v1/chat/completions` works with pure Bearer (HTTP 200, standard OpenAI SSE, `usage` present, verified with `model=lite` and `model=qmodel`). CN `gateway.qoder.com.cn/model/v1/*` returns **503** — CN requires the legacy COSY path. Plan P4 for Intl only unless COSY is ported.
- **`qfmodel` is `is_free=true, price_factor=0` but returns `invalid_model_error` on the chat endpoint** — `is_free` ≠ callable. Must probe callability separately before relying on catalog flags.

- **Account pools must carry `realm`**; the two local accounts have different uids and are not interchangeable.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

1: # ZCode 运营面接入说明（限时套餐自动探测与领取）
2: 
3: > 接入范围：**仅账号运营面**——本机凭据导入、限时套餐（赠送额度）探测与领取、额度查询、定时任务。
4: > **不含对话转发**：ZCode 的 messages 通道按设备指纹+追踪头识别客户端，头形态写错会触发上游 3012
5: > 「unusual activity」真风控。在未充分验证前刻意不并入转发池（`capability.chat=false`）。
6: 
7: ## 它解决什么
8: 
9: ZCode 客户端会不定期下发「限时领取」的赠送套餐（如 `ZCode Trust Build`：GLM-5.3-Flash ×1 亿 tokens，
10: 一次性或按日发放）。官方只在客户端里弹横幅，关闭就错过。本模块在 RelayGate 内定时探测并自动领取：
11: 
12: - 每日 **00:30** 与 **21:30**（本地时区）各探测一轮
13: - 有可领套餐 → 自动解验证码 → 自动 claim → 通知
14: - 已领取过（上游 1003）幂等跳过，不会重复请求
15: - 触发风控（3012）立即中止该账号并单独告警
16: 
17: ## 上游链路（实证）
18: 
19: ```
20: POST https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/event/report           ← app_launch + app_daily_active（无鉴权）
21: GET  https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/zcode-plan/billing/preview?app_version=   ← 可领套餐列表
22: POST https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/zcode-plan/billing/claim  {"plan_id"}    ← 领取（需验证码）
23: GET  https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/zcode-plan/billing/balance?app_version=   ← 额度
24: GET  https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/client/configs?app_version=               ← 验证码 scene 配置
25: ```
26: 
27: 业务码语义（`platform/variant.js` → `errors`）：
28: 
29: | code | 含义 | 处理 |
30: |---|---|---|
31: | 0 | 成功 | 落库 + 通知 |
32: | 1001 | 套餐不存在或已下架 | 失败 |
33: | 1002 | 活动结束 | 失败 |
34: | 1003 | 已领取过 | **幂等成功**（already） |
35: | 1004 | 不符合条件 | 失败 |
36: | 1005 | 今日名额用完 | 失败 |
37: | 3001 | 参数错误 | 失败（通常是头不全） |
38: | 3007 | 验证码校验失败 | **换码重试一次** |
39: | 3012 | 真风控 unusual activity | **中止该账号 + 告警** |
40: 
41: 关键实测结论（写代码时勿凭直觉改）：
42: 
43: 1. `billing/preview` **必须带全套客户端身份头**（`X-ZCode-App-Version` / `X-Platform` / `X-Device-Mid` …），
44:    裸请求直接 `3001 parameter error`。
45: 2. `client/configs` **禁止带 `platform` 参数**，带则 `3001`。
46: 3. `billing/claim` 的 `X-Platform` 是 `<platform>-<arch>` 形态（如 `win32-x64`），缺版本/平台头即使
47:    验证码有效也 `3007`。
48: 4. 验证码参数（`certifyId`）**一次性**，复用会被官方客户端同款 F008 重复提交检测拒绝；每次 claim 现解。
49: 5. 激活事件上报（app_launch/app_daily_active）是活动投放资格的疑似信号——官方客户端可见活动但
50:    preview 为空的不符点，多与漏报日活相关。探测前先上报，失败不阻断。
51: 
52: ## 快速开始
53: 
54: ### 1. 导入本机账号
55: 
56: 前提：本机装有 ZCode 桌面客户端且登录过（凭据文件 `~/.zcode/v2/credentials.json`）。
57: 
58: ```powershell
59: # 方式 A：调用 API（管理密钥鉴权）
60: POST /v1/zcode/local/import
61: 
62: # 方式 B：命令行脚本
63: node scripts/zcode-import-local.js
64: ```
65: 
66: 导入内容：`zcodejwttoken`（列级 AES-256-GCM 加密入库）、`user_id`、设备档案。
67: 客户端的 JWT 无 `exp` 字段、也不返回 refresh_token，**长期有效，无需保活**。
68: 
69: > 凭据解密密钥派生自客户端 asar 实现：`sha256("zcode-credential-fallback:<platform>:<homedir>:<username>")`。
70: > 若客户端重装或系统用户名变更导致解密失败，设 `ZCODE_CREDENTIAL_SECRET` 显式指定。
71: 
72: ### 2. 开启定时任务
73: 
74: ```powershell
75: # .env
76: ZCODE_REWARDS_ENABLED=true
77: ```
78: 
79: 或热改：`POST /v1/zcode/settings {"enabled": true}`。
80: 时段可在面板设置或 env 调整（默认 00:30 / 21:30）。
81: 
82: ### 3. 验证
83: 
84: ```powershell
85: # 状态（含求解器可用性）
86: GET /v1/zcode/status
87: 
88: # 手动跑一轮（探测 + 领取）
89: POST /v1/zcode/rewards/run
90: 
91: # 只探测不领取
92: POST /v1/zcode/accounts/<id>/rewards/probe
93: 
94: # 验证码自检（真实求解一次）
95: POST /v1/zcode/diagnose/captcha
96: ```
97: 
98: 结果在面板「任务日志」中查 `task=zcode-rewards`；通知走既有渠道
99: （事件：`zcode_reward_claimed` / `zcode_reward_failed` / `zcode_reward_risk`）。
100: 
101: ## 架构与文件
102: 
103: ```
104: src/platform/variant.js        ZCODE 变体表（域名/路径/业务码/能力位/时段）—— 单一事实源
105: src/zcode/
106:   fingerprint.js               每账号成套桌面设备档案（platform×arch×os×screen 绑定 + device_mid）
107:   identity.js                  billing 面身份头（pio 头集合；顺序与取值对齐官方客户端）
108:   client.js                    HTTP 通道（信封解析 / 业务码错误 / 代理复用）
109:   captcha.js                   阿里云无感验证码求解（子进程调 solver.js）
110:   rewards.js                   激活上报 / preview / claim / balance（业务核心）
111:   local.js                     本机客户端凭据解密导入（AES-256-GCM）
112: src/jobs/zcode-rewards.js      每日 00:30/21:30 定时（错峰 / 幂等 / 任务日志 / 通知）
113: src/routes/zcode.js            /v1/zcode 管理端点
114: scripts/zcode-import-local.js  命令行导入
115: scripts/zcode-e2e.js           端到端演练（真实打上游）
116: ```
117: 
118: ### 与既有系统的关系
119: 
120: - **账号库共用** `accounts` 表，`edition='zcode'` 区分；新增列 `api_key_enc` / `fingerprint` / `mode`
121:   （均可空，旧账号零影响）。
122: - **转发池隔离**：`pool.editionOk` 走 `variant.canChat` 能力位，zcode 账号不可能被 Trae/WorkBuddy
123:   请求选中；签到链、token 保活、账单扫描同样按能力位/白名单显式排除 zcode。
124: - **余额刷新**：`upstream/balance.js` 已分流——zcode 账号走自己的 `billing/balance`
125:   （token 计量），面板余额列显示剩余 token 数。
126: 
127: ### 验证码求解器
128: 
129: `billing/claim` 强制阿里云无感验证码。求解器复用 `zcode2api/captcha_node/solver.js`
130: （Node + happy-dom 模拟浏览器，无真实浏览器依赖），通过 `ZCODE_CAPTCHA_SOLVER_DIR` 指向：
131: 
132: ```
133: 默认：C:\opt\workstations\project\zcode2api\captcha_node
134: 首次：在该目录 npm install（本机已装好）
135: ```
136: 
137: 实测单次求解 2–8 秒，成功率约 2/3（阿里云 pe 字节码 VM 偶发 stall），代码内置 3 次重试，
138: 重试后仍失败记 `failed` 并在下轮重试——对每日两轮的节奏完全够用。
139: 
140: ## 配置项
141: 
142: | env | 默认 | 说明 |
143: |---|---|---|
144: | `ZCODE_REWARDS_ENABLED` | `false` | 定时任务总开关（默认关，避免影响现有池） |
145: | `ZCODE_REWARD_HOUR_1` / `_MINUTE_1` | `0` / `30` | 第一探测时段 |
146: | `ZCODE_REWARD_HOUR_2` / `_MINUTE_2` | `21` / `30` | 第二探测时段 |
147: | `ZCODE_REWARD_SPREAD_MINUTES` | `10` | 多账号错峰窗口（单账号无影响） |
148: | `ZCODE_REWARD_AUTO_CLAIM` | `true` | 关闭则只探测通知、不实际领取 |
149: | `ZCODE_APP_VERSION` | `3.14.4` | 客户端版本头 |
150: | `ZCODE_TIMEOUT_MS` | `25000` | 上游超时 |
151: | `ZCODE_CAPTCHA_SOLVER_DIR` | zcode2api 路径 | 求解器目录 |
152: | `ZCODE_NODE_PATH` | `node` | Node 可执行文件 |
153: | `ZCODE_CAPTCHA_RETRIES` | `3` | 单次领取的求解重试次数 |
154: | `ZCODE_CREDENTIAL_SECRET` | 派生 | 客户端凭据解密密钥（一般不用设） |
155: 
156: 时段/开关也可在 `.trae-api/zcode-settings.json` 热改（文件 > env > 默认）。
157: 
158: ## 计量口径隔离（关键约束，改代码前必读）
159: 
160: ZCode 的额度单位是 **token**（单包量级 1e8），而 RelayGate 既有「积分」体系
161: （balance 列 / entitlement_snapshot.packs / credit_history，单位 credit，量级 1e3）
162: 是两套完全不同的计量。**禁止把 token 数写进任何积分口径**，否则：
163: 
164: - 面板「可用额度 / 今日消耗」被抬高约 4 个数量级（实测单账号 86,560,855 tokens
165:   混进 ~5,400 credits 的日消耗，`totalUsed` 从 5,437 变 902,822,370）；
166: - 「3 日内到期积分」同样被污染；
167: - pool 的 FEFO 排序、`MIN_BALANCE_TO_USE` 过滤、低余额告警读到的是 token 数。
168: 
169: 约定（当前实现已遵守）：
170: 
171: | 位置 | ZCode 写入 | 积分消费方 |
172: |---|---|---|
173: | `accounts.balance` | 恒 `null` | pool / credit-alerts / 面板余额列 |
174: | `entitlement_snapshot.packs` | **不写** | `creditTotals` / `summarizeExpiry` / `summarizeFefo` / FEFO 排序 |
175: | `entitlement_snapshot.tokenBuckets` | ✔ 写（token 桶 + `tokenRemaining`） | 无积分消费方 |

{"content":"# Qoder 运营面接入说明（双区域每日积分自动领取）

> 接入范围：**仅账号运营面**——本机凭据导入（国际版 + 国内版）、每日 100 Credits 积分活动查询与领取、
> 额度查询、模型目录同步、定时任务。
> **不含对话转发**：见下方「为什么不启用转发面」——两个区域的协议都没经多账号验证。

Qoder 客户端每天可领 **100 Credits**（有效期 30 日），官方只在客户端内弹横幅，关闭就错过。
本模块在 RelayGate 内定时自动领取，并支持查询两段隔离的额度与同步模型目录（含限免标识）。

- 每日 **10:15**（本地时区）执行一轮 —— 上游规则是「每日 10:00（UTC+8）刷新」
- 有可领积分活动 → 自动 claim → 通知；已领取幂等跳过，不会重复发放
- 双区域（国内版 / 国际版）账号体系独立，**realm 随账号持久化**

## 它解决什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 每日积分领取 | 上游 `CLAIM_BENEFIT` + `CREDITS` 活动，100 credits / 30 天 |
| 额度查询 | `userQuota`（基础 300）与 `addOnQuota`（赠送/签到 100）**两段隔离展示** |
| 模型目录 | 国内版走 COSY 动态拉取，国际版可解密本机 QMC 缓存；含 `is_free` 限免标识 |
| 本机导入 | 解密桌面客户端 `auth.v1.dat`（Chromium os_crypt v10 + DPAPI），两个区域各一个账号 |

## 双区域差异（核心）

Qoder 有**两套完全独立的账号体系**（uid 不同、不互通），域名与协议都不同：

| | 国内版（cn） | 国际版（intl） |
|---|---|---|
| 客户端目录 | `%APPDATA%\com.qodercn.app.stable` | `%APPDATA%\com.qoder.app.stable` |
| 家目录 | `~/.qoder-cn` | `~/.qoder` |
| 运营面基址 | `openapi.qoder.com.cn` | `openapi.qoder.sh` |
| 网关基址 | `gateway.qoder.com.cn` | `api2-v2.qoder.sh` |
| 对话协议 | COSY 老版（签名 + 自定义 Base64） | 新版 OpenAI 兼容（纯 Bearer） |
| 模型目录 | COSY `model/list`（14 个） | QMC 缓存 / COSY（18 / 17 个） |
| 账号示例 | `874741101@qq.com`（sso.aliyun） | `werrice@outlook.com`（sso.github） |

**realm 只能由「扫到哪个客户端目录」确定，之后随账号持久化（`accounts.qoder_realm`）。
严禁按域名后缀推导** —— 国际版客户端的 `fastEndpoint` 实测指向 `api6.qoder.com.cn`，
一个 `.com.cn` 域名，靠 host 猜会把国际版误判成国内版。这条约束由单测
`关键实证：国际版 fastEndpoint 是 .com.cn 域名，realm 不得由域名推导` 守门。

### realm 驱动什么

```
realm ─┬─→ 域名选择      variant.qoderOpenapiBase(realm) / qoderGatewayBase(realm)
       ├─→ 对话协议      realms[realm].chatProtocol（cosy | openai）
       └─→ 目录获取方式  catalog.syncCatalog()：cn 只能 COSY，intl 可 QMC 缓存
```

## 上游链路（实证）

运营面双区域同构，仅域名不同。以国内版为例：

```
GET  https://openapi.qoder.com.cn/api/v1/userinfo                  ← 身份校验
GET  https://openapi.qoder.com.cn/api/v2/quota/usage               ← 两段额度
GET  https://openapi.qoder.com.cn/sash/api/v1/me/campaigns         ← 活动列表
POST https://openapi.qoder.com.cn/sash/api/v1/me/campaigns/{id}/claim  ← 领取
```

活动条目形态：

```jsonc
{
  "campaignId": "act-20261013-250",
  "campaignKey": "act-20261013-250",
  "actionType": "CLAIM_BENEFIT",          // 可领取；VIEW_DETAILS 是纯展示
  "claimStatus": "CLAIMABLE",             // CLAIMABLE | CLAIMED
  "benefit": {
    "kind": "CREDITS",                    // 只处理 CREDITS
    "amount": 100,
    "validity": { "mode": "RELATIVE_DAYS", "days": 30 }   // 领取后 30 天，非月底
  },
  "placements": [{ "content": { "zh": { "title": "每天领 100 Credits",
                                        "description": "每日 10:00（UTC+8）刷新…" } } }]
}
```

领取响应：`{ grantId, status:"CLAIMED", replayed, benefit, campaignId, campaignKey, claimedAt, grantedAt, expiresAt }`

关键实测结论（写代码时勿凭直觉改）：

1. **桌面端请求头是 load-bearing 的**。`/sash/*` 必须带
   `User-Agent: Qoder` / `cosy-clienttype: 10` / `cosy-version: 0.4.3`。
   缺了**不报错但返回空活动列表**——最难排查的一类失败。
2. **`cosy-machine*` 六头必须整体省略**。本服务跑在服务器、无官方原生桥，
   发派生假值会被服务端判定非官方客户端，把「每日 100 Credits」整条过滤掉
   （qoder2api-hub 逐头隔离实测）。国际版在服务器部署时可能因此看不到活动，
   代码里 `omitMachineHeaders: true` 并会在通知中明示。
3. **幂等靠上游保证**。对已领取活动重复 claim 返回同一 `grantId` + `replayed:true`，
   额度不重复增加。实测国内版 `grantId 01a13473-be68-7a01-a9f5-3c8263e633d2`，
   重复领取后 `addOnQuota` 仍是 100。
4. **`is_free` ≠ 可调用**。`qfmodel`（Qwen3.8-Flash）在目录里 `is_free=true, price_factor=0`，
   但在 chat 端点返回 `invalid_model_error`。可调用集合必须实测探测，
   不能按目录字段推断（单测 `关键实证：is_free ≠ 可调用` 守门）。
5. **`mmodel` 同名不同值**：国际版 MiniMax-M3，国内版 MiniMax-M2.7。
   目录必须按 realm 分开存，禁止合并成一张全局表（单测守门）。
6. **国内版 `/model/v1/*` 实测 503**，对话只能走 COSY 老协议。

## 快速开始

### 1. 导入本机账号

前提：本机装有 Qoder 桌面客户端（国际版和/或国内版）且已登录。

```powershell
# 方式 A：调用 API（管理密钥鉴权）
POST /v1/qoder/local/import                  # 导入全部已登录区域（幂等）
POST /v1/qoder/local/import/cn               # 只导入国内版
POST /v1/qoder/local/import/intl             # 只导入国际版

# 预检（不解密全文，只看装没装、登没登、有哪些账号）
GET /v1/qoder/local/preview
```

导入内容：`dt-` access token + `drt-` refresh token（列级 AES-256-GCM 加密入库）、
`user_id`、`user_name`、`user_email`、`expiresAt`、`qoder_realm`。

> 凭据解密链路：客户端 `auth.v1.dat` = `"v10" + nonce(12) + AES-256-GCM(ct+tag)`；
> 密钥在同目录 `Local State` 的 `os_crypt.encrypted_key`（base64，去掉 5 字节 `DPAPI`
> 前缀后经 Windows DPAPI `CryptUnprotectData` 解出 32 字节）。
> DPAPI 无 Node 原生绑定，通过 `powershell.exe` 调
> `[System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData]::Unprotect`，base64 **经 stdin 传**
> （命令行传参会被 PowerShell 当裸 token 解析，ParserError）。
> **仅在 Windows 本机可用**：服务端部署在 Linux 时凭据应先在 Windows 上导入再同步库。

### 2. 开启定时任务

```powershell
# .env
QODER_REWARDS_ENABLED=true
```

或热改：`POST /v1/qoder/settings {"enabled": true}`。

默认 **10:15** 本地时区。若部署机时区不是 UTC+8，调整 `hour`/`minute`
使执行时刻落在上游 UTC+8 10:00 刷新之后（早于刷新会拿到空列表，晚太多错过当日）。

### 3. 验证

```powershell
GET  /v1/qoder/status                        # 平台能力 + 任务状态 + 客户端探测
GET  /v1/qoder/accounts                      # 账号列表（脱敏 + 奖励摘要）
GET  /v1/qoder/accounts/<id>/campaigns       # 活动列表
GET  /v1/qoder/accounts/<id>/quota           # 两段额度
POST /v1/qoder/accounts/<id>/claim           # 领取（body 可带 campaignId）
GET  /v1/qoder/accounts/<id>/models?prefer=cosy   # 模型目录（cosy|cache|auto）
POST /v1/qoder/run?claim=false               # 全账号跑一轮（只探测）
```

命令行演练：

```powershell
node scripts/test-qoder-integration.js       # 28 项真实上游 + 真实客户端集成测试
node src/test/qoder.test.js                  # 50 项单测（无网络）
```

结果在面板「任务日志」中查 `task=qoder-rewards`；通知走既有渠道
（事件：`qoder_reward_claimed` / `qoder_reward_failed` / `qoder_reward_empty` / `qoder_reward_already`）。

## 架构与文件

```
src/platform/variant.js        QODER 变体表（realms 域名/路径/能力位/时段）—— 单一事实源
src/qoder/
  crypto.js                    os_crypt v10 解密 + DPAPI（PowerShell stdin）
  local.js                     双区域客户端凭据扫描、探测、导入（幂等）
  client.js                    HTTP 通道（桌面端头 / 信封解析 / 区域不可用）
  rewards.js                   campaigns / claim / quota / probe（业务核心）
  catalog.js                   COSY 签名 + 自定义 Base64 + QMC 解密 + 目录归一
src/jobs/qoder-rewards.js      每日 10:15 定时（错峰 / 幂等 / 任务日志 / 通知）
src/routes/qoder.js            /v1/qoder 管理端点
src/test/qoder.test.js         单测（无网络、无真实客户端）
scripts/test-qoder-integration.js  集成测试（真实上游 + 真实客户端）
```

### 与既有系统的关系

- **账号库共用** `accounts` 表，`edition='qoder'` 区分；新增列 `qoder_realm`
  （可空，旧账号零影响，`ensureSchema()` 条件 `ALTER TABLE` 迁移）。
- **转发池隔离**：`pool.editionOk` 走 `variant.canChat` 能力位，`capability.chat=false`，
  qoder 账号不可能被 Trae/WorkBuddy 请求选中；`capability.checkin=false`，
  qoder **不进入** `checkin-all` 的平台枚举（积分领取走自有时段任务，不是「今日签到」语义）。
- **余额刷新**：`upstream/balance.js` 已分流——qoder 账号走 `refreshQoderBalance`。
- **前端**：`platformOf()` 新增 `'qoder'`；余额列对 qoder 账号显示 `quota.totalRemaining`
  并标注 `cr`；签到按钮对 qoder 隐藏；来源筛选器补齐 zcode/qoder（此前只特判 workbuddy，
  选「Trae」时列表与「全部」相同——一并修复）。
- **标定键**：`pricing-calib.calibKey` 为 qoder 独立前缀（`qoder:qfmodel`），
  避免与 Trae/WorkBuddy 的模型名归一到同一串。

### 计量口径隔离（关键约束，改代码前必读）

Qoder 的额度是**两段独立**的：`userQuota`（套餐内基础，300）+ `addOnQuota`（赠送/签到，
100，每日积分 landing 进这里）。单位都是 credit，但语义不同（addOn 由活动产生）。

**禁止把两段加总后写进积分口径**——这正是 ZCode 曾踩过的坑（token 数混进 credits，
面板「今日消耗」被抬高 4 个数量级）。当前实现约定：

| 位置 | Qoder 写入 | 积分消费方 |
|---|---|---|
| `accounts.balance` | 恒 `null` | pool / credit-alerts / 面板余额列 |
| `entitlement_snapshot.packs` | **不写** | `creditTotals` / `summarizeExpiry` / `summarizeFefo` / FEFO 排序 |
| `entitlementSnapshot.quota` | ✔ 写（base / addOn / totalRemaining 嵌套键） | 无积分消费方 |
| `credit_history` | **不写** | `/v1/admin/credit-history` 的 `totalUsed` |

前端展示：CredentialsPage 对 qoder 账号显示 `quota.totalRemaining` 并标注 `cr` 单位，
tooltip 明示「基础 X + 赠送 Y，两段隔离，不计入积分汇总」。

## 配置项

| env | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `QODER_REWARDS_ENABLED` | `false` | 定时任务总开关（默认关，避免影响现有池） |
| `QODER_REWARD_HOUR` | `10` | 执行时刻（本地时区小时） |
| `QODER_REWARD_MINUTE` | `15` | 执行时刻（本地时区分钟） |
| `QODER_REWARD_SPREAD_MINUTES` | `10` | 多账号确定性错峰窗口（单账号无影响） |
| `QODER_REWARD_AUTO_CLAIM` | `true` | 关闭则只探测通知、不实际领取 |
| `QODER_TIMEOUT_MS` | `25000` | 上游超时 |
| `QODER_CN_APP_DIR` / `QODER_INTL_APP_DIR` | — | 覆盖客户端目录（便携版/非默认安装） |

时段/开关也可在 `.trae-api/qoder-settings.json` 热改（文件 > env > 默认）。

## 为什么不启用转发面

两个区域的对话协议都**未做多账号验证**，直接并入转发池有真实风控风险：

- **国际版**：`POST api2-v2.qoder.sh/model/v1/chat/completions` 纯 Bearer、OpenAI 兼容 SSE、
  `usage` 齐全，单账号实测 HTTP 200 打通。但只验了一个账号，未验证并发与限流阈值。
- **国内版**：`gateway.qoder.com.cn/model/v1/*` 实测 **503**，必须走 COSY 老协议
  （`/algo/api/v2/service/pro/sse/agent_chat_generation`，RSA 包裹密钥 + MD5 签名 +
  自定义 Base64 请求体），实现成本高且同样未经多账号验证。

因此 `capability.chat=false`。COSY 的实现已在 `src/qoder/catalog.js`
（`cosyHeaders` / `qoderEncode`）落地并实测可拉到模型目录，将来启用转发面时无需重写签名。

COSY 实现的四个易错点（错一个就是 `{"code":"101","message":"Signature invalid"}`）：

| 项 | 正确值 | 易错值 |
|---|---|---|
| `cosyVersion` | `1.1.64` | `0.4.3`（桌面版版本号，不是协议版本） |
| `ideVersion` | `""` | 任意非空 |
| `version` | `"v1"` | 其它 |
| identity 键集 | 9 键：`name/aid/uid/yx_uid/organization_id/organization_name/user_type/security_oauth_token/refresh_token` | `machine*` 字段 |

另：请求必须带同款 body（`qoderEncode("{}")`）且用 `node:https` 的 `GET` + `req.write(body)`
——Node 的 `fetch` 不允许 GET 带 body，改 POST 会被上游拒（`Request method 'POST' not supported`）。

## 风险与边界

- **只自动领取本机已登录账号自己的活动奖励**，不做多账号批量刷活动——那属于风控对象。
- 上游对已领取活动幂等（`replayed:true`），重复请求不会重复发放，但**仍不应高频调用**。
  定时任务每日一轮 + 错峰，天然保守。
- 空活动列表分两种情况，代码分别计数并通知：`alreadyToday`（当日已领，正常）
  与 `emptyList`（上游无活动或桌面端头被过滤，需人工判断）。
- `realm` 是账号的持久属性，导入后不变。若同一区域换账号登录，重新导入会按
  `realm + userId` 更新既有记录而非新建。
- DPAPI 解密仅 Windows 可用；Linux 服务端需在 Windows 上导入后同步数据库文件。

{"content":"# Qoder 运营面接入说明（双区域每日积分自动领取）

> 接入范围：**仅账号运营面**——本机凭据导入（国际版 + 国内版）、每日 100 Credits 积分活动查询与领取、
> 额度查询、模型目录同步、定时任务。
> **不含对话转发**：见下方「为什么不启用转发面」——两个区域的协议都没经多账号验证。

Qoder 客户端每天可领 **100 Credits**（有效期 30 日），官方只在客户端内弹横幅，关闭就错过。
本模块在 RelayGate 内定时自动领取，并支持查询两段隔离的额度与同步模型目录（含限免标识）。

- 每日 **10:15**（本地时区）执行一轮 —— 上游规则是「每日 10:00（UTC+8）刷新」
- 有可领积分活动 → 自动 claim → 通知；已领取幂等跳过，不会重复发放
- 双区域（国内版 / 国际版）账号体系独立，**realm 随账号持久化**

## 它解决什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 每日积分领取 | 上游 `CLAIM_BENEFIT` + `CREDITS` 活动，100 credits / 30 天 |
| 额度查询 | `userQuota`（基础 300）与 `addOnQuota`（赠送/签到 100）**两段隔离展示** |
| 模型目录 | 国内版走 COSY 动态拉取，国际版可解密本机 QMC 缓存；含 `is_free` 限免标识 |
| 本机导入 | 解密桌面客户端 `auth.v1.dat`（Chromium os_crypt v10 + DPAPI），两个区域各一个账号 |

## 双区域差异（核心）

Qoder 有**两套完全独立的账号体系**（uid 不同、不互通），域名与协议都不同：

| | 国内版（cn） | 国际版（intl） |
|---|---|---|
| 客户端目录 | `%APPDATA%\com.qodercn.app.stable` | `%APPDATA%\com.qoder.app.stable` |
| 家目录 | `~/.qoder-cn` | `~/.qoder` |
| 运营面基址 | `openapi.qoder.com.cn` | `openapi.qoder.sh` |
| 网关基址 | `gateway.qoder.com.cn` | `api2-v2.qoder.sh` |
| 对话协议 | COSY 老版（签名 + 自定义 Base64） | 新版 OpenAI 兼容（纯 Bearer） |
| 模型目录 | COSY `model/list`（14 个） | QMC 缓存 / COSY（18 / 17 个） |
| 账号示例 | `874741101@qq.com`（sso.aliyun） | `werrice@outlook.com`（sso.github） |

**realm 只能由「扫到哪个客户端目录」确定，之后随账号持久化（`accounts.qoder_realm`）。
严禁按域名后缀推导** —— 国际版客户端的 `fastEndpoint` 实测指向 `api6.qoder.com.cn`，
一个 `.com.cn` 域名，靠 host 猜会把国际版误判成国内版。这条约束由单测
`关键实证：国际版 fastEndpoint 是 .com.cn 域名，realm 不得由域名推导` 守门。

### realm 驱动什么

```
realm ─┬─→ 域名选择      variant.qoderOpenapiBase(realm) / qoderGatewayBase(realm)
       ├─→ 对话协议      realms[realm].chatProtocol（cosy | openai）
       └─→ 目录获取方式  catalog.syncCatalog()：cn 只能 COSY，intl 可 QMC 缓存
```

## 上游链路（实证）

运营面双区域同构，仅域名不同。以国内版为例：

```
GET  https://openapi.qoder.com.cn/api/v1/userinfo                  ← 身份校验
GET  https://openapi.qoder.com.cn/api/v2/quota/usage               ← 两段额度
GET  https://openapi.qoder.com.cn/sash/api/v1/me/campaigns         ← 活动列表
POST https://openapi.qoder.com.cn/sash/api/v1/me/campaigns/{id}/claim  ← 领取
```

活动条目形态：

```jsonc
{
  "campaignId": "act-20261013-250",
  "campaignKey": "act-20261013-250",
  "actionType": "CLAIM_BENEFIT",          // 可领取；VIEW_DETAILS 是纯展示
  "claimStatus": "CLAIMABLE",             // CLAIMABLE | CLAIMED
  "benefit": {
    "kind": "CREDITS",                    // 只处理 CREDITS
    "amount": 100,
    "validity": { "mode": "RELATIVE_DAYS", "days": 30 }   // 领取后 30 天，非月底
  },
  "placements": [{ "content": { "zh": { "title": "每天领 100 Credits",
                                        "description": "每日 10:00（UTC+8）刷新…" } } }]
}
```

领取响应：`{ grantId, status:"CLAIMED", replayed, benefit, campaignId, campaignKey, claimedAt, grantedAt, expiresAt }`

关键实测结论（写代码时勿凭直觉改）：

1. **桌面端请求头是 load-bearing 的**。`/sash/*` 必须带
   `User-Agent: Qoder` / `cosy-clienttype: 10` / `cosy-version: 0.4.3`。
   缺了**不报错但返回空活动列表**——最难排查的一类失败。
2. **`cosy-machine*` 六头必须整体省略**。本服务跑在服务器、无官方原生桥，
   发派生假值会被服务端判定非官方客户端，把「每日 100 Credits」整条过滤掉
   （qoder2api-hub 逐头隔离实测）。国际版在服务器部署时可能因此看不到活动，
   代码里 `omitMachineHeaders: true` 并会在通知中明示。
3. **幂等靠上游保证**。对已领取活动重复 claim 返回同一 `grantId` + `replayed:true`，
   额度不重复增加。实测国内版 `grantId 01a13473-be68-7a01-a9f5-3c8263e633d2`，
   重复领取后 `addOnQuota` 仍是 100。
4. **`is_free` ≠ 可调用**。`qfmodel`（Qwen3.8-Flash）在目录里 `is_free=true, price_factor=0`，
   但在 chat 端点返回 `invalid_model_error`。可调用集合必须实测探测，
   不能按目录字段推断（单测 `关键实证：is_free ≠ 可调用` 守门）。
5. **`mmodel` 同名不同值**：国际版 MiniMax-M3，国内版 MiniMax-M2.7。
   目录必须按 realm 分开存，禁止合并成一张全局表（单测守门）。
6. **国内版 `/model/v1/*` 实测 503**，对话只能走 COSY 老协议。

## 快速开始

### 1. 导入本机账号

前提：本机装有 Qoder 桌面客户端（国际版和/或国内版）且已登录。

```powershell
# 方式 A：调用 API（管理密钥鉴权）
POST /v1/qoder/local/import                  # 导入全部已登录区域（幂等）
POST /v1/qoder/local/import/cn               # 只导入国内版
POST /v1/qoder/local/import/intl             # 只导入国际版

# 预检（不解密全文，只看装没装、登没登、有哪些账号）
GET /v1/qoder/local/preview
```

导入内容：`dt-` access token + `drt-` refresh token（列级 AES-256-GCM 加密入库）、
`user_id`、`user_name`、`user_email`、`expiresAt`、`qoder_realm`。

> 凭据解密链路：客户端 `auth.v1.dat` = `"v10" + nonce(12) + AES-256-GCM(ct+tag)`；
> 密钥在同目录 `Local State` 的 `os_crypt.encrypted_key`（base64，去掉 5 字节 `DPAPI`
> 前缀后经 Windows DPAPI `CryptUnprotectData` 解出 32 字节）。
> DPAPI 无 Node 原生绑定，通过 `powershell.exe` 调
> `[System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData]::Unprotect`，base64 **经 stdin 传**
> （命令行传参会被 PowerShell 当裸 token 解析，ParserError）。
> **仅在 Windows 本机可用**：服务端部署在 Linux 时凭据应先在 Windows 上导入再同步库。

### 2. 开启定时任务

```powershell
# .env
QODER_REWARDS_ENABLED=true
```

或热改：`POST /v1/qoder/settings {"enabled": true}`。

默认 **10:15** 本地时区。若部署机时区不是 UTC+8，调整 `hour`/`minute`
使执行时刻落在上游 UTC+8 10:00 刷新之后（早于刷新会拿到空列表，晚太多错过当日）。

### 3. 验证

```powershell
GET  /v1/qoder/status                        # 平台能力 + 任务状态 + 客户端探测
GET  /v1/qoder/accounts                      # 账号列表（脱敏 + 奖励摘要）
GET  /v1/qoder/accounts/<id>/campaigns       # 活动列表
GET  /v1/qoder/accounts/<id>/quota           # 两段额度
POST /v1/qoder/accounts/<id>/claim           # 领取（body 可带 campaignId）
GET  /v1/qoder/accounts/<id>/models?prefer=cosy   # 模型目录（cosy|cache|auto）
POST /v1/qoder/run?claim=false               # 全账号跑一轮（只探测）
```

命令行演练：

```powershell
node scripts/test-qoder-integration.js       # 28 项真实上游 + 真实客户端集成测试
node src/test/qoder.test.js                  # 50 项单测（无网络）
```

结果在面板「任务日志」中查 `task=qoder-rewards`；通知走既有渠道
（事件：`qoder_reward_claimed` / `qoder_reward_failed` / `qoder_reward_empty` / `qoder_reward_already`）。

## 架构与文件

```
src/platform/variant.js        QODER 变体表（realms 域名/路径/能力位/时段）—— 单一事实源
src/qoder/
  crypto.js                    os_crypt v10 解密 + DPAPI（PowerShell stdin）
  local.js                     双区域客户端凭据扫描、探测、导入（幂等）
  client.js                    HTTP 通道（桌面端头 / 信封解析 / 区域不可用）
  rewards.js                   campaigns / claim / quota / probe（业务核心）
  catalog.js                   COSY 签名 + 自定义 Base64 + QMC 解密 + 目录归一
src/jobs/qoder-rewards.js      每日 10:15 定时（错峰 / 幂等 / 任务日志 / 通知）
src/routes/qoder.js            /v1/qoder 管理端点
src/test/qoder.test.js         单测（无网络、无真实客户端）
scripts/test-qoder-integration.js  集成测试（真实上游 + 真实客户端）
```

### 与既有系统的关系

- **账号库共用** `accounts` 表，`edition='qoder'` 区分；新增列 `qoder_realm`
  （可空，旧账号零影响，`ensureSchema()` 条件 `ALTER TABLE` 迁移）。
- **转发池隔离**：`pool.editionOk` 走 `variant.canChat` 能力位，`capability.chat=false`，
  qoder 账号不可能被 Trae/WorkBuddy 请求选中；`capability.checkin=false`，
  qoder **不进入** `checkin-all` 的平台枚举（积分领取走自有时段任务，不是「今日签到」语义）。
- **余额刷新**：`upstream/balance.js` 已分流——qoder 账号走 `refreshQoderBalance`。
- **前端**：`platformOf()` 新增 `'qoder'`；余额列对 qoder 账号显示 `quota.totalRemaining`
  并标注 `cr`；签到按钮对 qoder 隐藏；来源筛选器补齐 zcode/qoder（此前只特判 workbuddy，
  选「Trae」时列表与「全部」相同——一并修复）。
- **标定键**：`pricing-calib.calibKey` 为 qoder 独立前缀（`qoder:qfmodel`），
  避免与 Trae/WorkBuddy 的模型名归一到同一串。

### 计量口径隔离（关键约束，改代码前必读）

100，每日积分 landing 进这里）。单位都是 credit，但语义不同（addOn 由活动产生）。

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 每日积分领取 | 上游 `CLAIM_BENEFIT` + `CREDITS` 活动，100 credits / 30 天 |

> **仅在 Windows 本机可用**：服务端部署在 Linux 时凭据应先在 Windows 上导入再同步库。

```powershell
# .env
QODER_REWARDS_ENABLED=true

默认 **10:15** 本地时区。若部署机时区不是 UTC+8，调整 `hour`/`minute`

- 上游对已领取活动幂等（`replayed:true`），重复请求不会重复发放，但**仍不应高频调用**。
  定时任务每日一轮 + 错峰，天然保守。
- 空活动列表分两种情况，代码分别计数并通知：`alreadyToday`（当日已领，正常）
  与 `emptyList`（上游无活动或桌面端头被过滤，需人工判断）。
- `realm` 是账号的持久属性，导入后不变。若同一区域换账号登录，重新导入会按
  `realm + userId` 更新既有记录而非新建。
- DPAPI 解密仅 Windows 可用；Linux 服务端需在 Windows 上导入后同步数据库文件。

### F5. Qoder / ZCode 的对话转发未启用

- **现状**：两个平台都只接入了账号运营面（凭据导入 / 积分或套餐领取 / 额度查询 /
  模型目录），`capability.chat=false`，账号不可能被转发池选中。
- **为什么这样**：两者的对话协议都**未经多账号验证**。
  - ZCode：messages 通道按设备指纹 + 追踪头识别客户端，头形态写错会触发上游 3012
    「unusual activity」真风控。
  - Qoder：国际版新版协议（`api2-v2.qoder.sh/model/v1/chat/completions`）纯 Bearer、
    OpenAI 兼容 SSE，单账号实测打通；但国内版同路径实测 503，必须走 COSY 老协议
    （RSA 包裹密钥 + MD5 签名 + 自定义 Base64 请求体）。两者都只验了一个账号，
    未验证并发与限流阈值。
- **重新评估的条件**：用独立小号做并发 + 长时间压测，确认无风控触发后再启用。
  Qoder 的 COSY 签名实现已在 `src/qoder/catalog.js` 落地并实测可用（模型目录），
  启用转发面时无需重写签名部分。详见 `docs/qoder-integration-guide.md`。

### F6. Qoder 积分任务在非 UTC+8 时区需手动对齐时刻

- **现状**：定时任务默认本地时区 10:15 执行；上游规则是「每日 10:00（UTC+8）刷新」。
- **为什么这样**：调度器只支持本地时刻，无法表达「UTC+8 10:00」。
  默认值对 UTC+8 部署是准确的；其它时区需用户按 `QODER_REWARD_HOUR` / `_MINUTE`
  或 `POST /v1/qoder/settings` 调整，否则会早于刷新拿到空列表或错过当日。
- **重新评估的条件**：部署机时区固定且非 UTC+8 时，在部署文档里写明应对齐到的本地时刻。

### F7. Qoder 本机凭据导入仅 Windows 可用

- **现状**：`src/qoder/crypto.js` 的 DPAPI 解密依赖 `powershell.exe` +
  `[System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData]`，非 Windows 直接报错。
- **为什么这样**：Qoder 桌面客户端只在 Windows 上分发凭据文件，DPAPI 密文绑
  CurrentUser，换机器/换用户本就解不开。
- **重新评估的条件**：无需评估——Linux 服务端的正确做法是在 Windows 上导入后同步库文件。","old_string":"- **已知安全状况**：资源 ACL 校验本身是生效的（越权会 403），只是面板不暴露入口。
- **重新评估的条件**：需要给第三方分发受限密钥时。"}

- **重新评估的条件**：需要给第三方分发受限密钥时。

### F5. Qoder / ZCode 的对话转发未启用

- **现状**：两个平台都只接入了账号运营面（凭据导入 / 积分或套餐领取 / 额度查询 /
  模型目录），`capability.chat=false`，账号不可能被转发池选中。
- **为什么这样**：两者的对话协议都**未经多账号验证**。
  - ZCode：messages 通道按设备指纹 + 追踪头识别客户端，头形态写错会触发上游 3012
    「unusual activity」真风控。
  - Qoder：国际版新版协议（`api2-v2.qoder.sh/model/v1/chat/completions`）纯 Bearer、
    OpenAI 兼容 SSE，单账号实测打通；但国内版同路径实测 503，必须走 COSY 老协议
    （RSA 包裹密钥 + MD5 签名 + 自定义 Base64 请求体）。两者都只验了一个账号，
    未验证并发与限流阈值。
- **重新评估的条件**：用独立小号做并发 + 长时间压测，确认无风控触发后再启用。
  Qoder 的 COSY 签名实现已在 `src/qoder/catalog.js` 落地并实测可用（模型目录），
  启用转发面时无需重写签名部分。详见 `docs/qoder-integration-guide.md`。

### F6. Qoder 积分任务在非 UTC+8 时区需手动对齐时刻

- **现状**：定时任务默认本地时区 10:15 执行；上游规则是「每日 10:00（UTC+8）刷新」。
- **为什么这样**：调度器只支持本地时刻，无法表达「UTC+8 10:00」。
  默认值对 UTC+8 部署是准确的；其它时区需用户按 `QODER_REWARD_HOUR` / `_MINUTE`
  或 `POST /v1/qoder/settings` 调整，否则会早于刷新拿到空列表或错过当日。
- **重新评估的条件**：部署机时区固定且非 UTC+8 时，在部署文档里写明应对齐到的本地时刻。

### F7. Qoder 本机凭据导入仅 Windows 可用

- **现状**：`src/qoder/crypto.js` 的 DPAPI 解密依赖 `powershell.exe` +
  `[System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData]`，非 Windows 直接报错。
- **为什么这样**：Qoder 桌面客户端只在 Windows 上分发凭据文件，DPAPI 密文绑
  CurrentUser，换机器/换用户本就解不开。
- **重新评估的条件**：无需评估——Linux 服务端的正确做法是在 Windows 上导入后同步库文件。

## 实施结果

**P1 双区域凭据导入** — 两个 realm 都从真机客户端解出了 `dt-`/`drt-` token：
- `src/qoder/crypto.js`：`auth.v1.dat` = `"v10" + nonce(12) + AES-256-GCM`；密钥从 `Local State` 的 `os_crypt.encrypted_key` 去 `DPAPI` 前缀后，经 `powershell.exe` 调 `ProtectedData::Unprotect`（base64 走 stdin，命令行传参会 ParserError）
- `src/qoder/local.js`：扫 `com.qodercn.app.stable` 与 `com.qoder.app.stable` 两个目录，**realm 由扫到哪个目录确定**——国际版客户端的 `fastEndpoint` 实测指向 `api6.qoder.com.cn`，按域名后缀猜会误判
- 新增 `accounts.qoder_realm` 列（条件 `ALTER TABLE` 迁移，旧账号零影响）

**P2 每日积分领取** — 默认 10:15 本地时区（上游 UTC+8 10:00 刷新）：
- 国内版 uid `01a1346c…` / 国际版 uid `019f0dea…` 两个账号活动查询均 200，`amount=100`、`validity=RELATIVE_DAYS/30`
- 幂等靠上游：重复 claim 返回同一 `grantId` + `replayed:true`，`addOnQuota` 保持 100 不增
- 空活动列表分 `alreadyToday`（当日已领）与 `emptyList`（桌面端头被过滤）两种计数并分别通知

**P3 模型目录** — 国内版 COSY 14 个、国际版 QMC 缓存 18 个 / COSY 17 个；`qfmodel` 双区域 `is_free=true, price_factor=0`；`mmodel` 国内版 MiniMax-M2.7 vs 国际版 M3（同名不同值，目录禁止合并）

## 关键设计决策

| 决策 | 依据 |
|---|---|
| `capability.chat=false` | 国际版新版协议单账号打通但未验并发；国内版 `/model/v1/*` 实测 503 必须走 COSY |
| `capability.checkin=false` | Qoder 是「活动领取」不是「今日签到」语义，走自有时段任务，不进 `checkin-all` 枚举 |
| 省略 `cosy-machine*` 六头 | 服务器无原生桥，发派生假值会被服务端把每日 100 活动整条过滤掉 |
| 额度写 `entitlementSnapshot.quota` 嵌套键 | `userQuota`(300) 与 `addOnQuota`(100) 两段独立，加总进积分口径会重演 ZCode 的污染事故 |

## 验证

- `npm test`：**407 passed, 0 failed**（新增 50 项 qoder 单测，无网络无真实客户端）
- `scripts/test-qoder-integration.js`：**28 passed, 0 failed**（真实上游 + 真实本机客户端，连跑两轮稳定）
- `npm run lint` 与 `npm run build:web` 均 exit 0
- `/v1/qoder` 全端点端到端实测：未鉴权 401、非 qoder 账号 400、不存在账号 404、导入/活动/额度/领取/目录/批量/设置均 200

顺手修了一个既有 bug：CredentialsPage 的来源筛选器此前只特判 `workbuddy`，选「Trae」时列表与「全部」完全相同；现已改为四平台等值匹配并补齐 zcode/qoder 选项。

文档：[qoder-integration-guide.md](docs/qoder-integration-guide.md)（实施与运维）、[qoder-integration-analysis-v2.md](docs/qoder-integration-analysis-v2.md)（分析实证记录，已标注已实施）、[known-limitations.md](docs/known-limitations.md)（新增 F5–F7 三条边界）。

summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- **Original (verbatim):** "分析新的接入任务，`C:\opt\workstations\agents\Qoder`，Qcoder 每日10点后可领取100积分，有效期三十日，并且客户端内，Qwen3.8-Flash限免。研究如何在本项目接入Qoder。"
- **Evolving (verbatim):** User supplied 6 GitHub repos and asked "结合上述项目，以及本项目的经验，重新评估分析"; then "现在结合方案，分析国际版和国内版的区别，并实际解包验证，国内版现在还没有签到，你可以尝试签到测试。" with `C:\opt\workstations\agents\Qoder CN`
- **Latest (verbatim):** "开始实施。" — Begin implementation of the P1/P2/P3 plan.
- Deliverable: analysis docs in `docs/` + actual code in `src/qoder/` following the ZCode precedent.

## Key Technical Concepts
- **RelayGate**: multi-platform account-pool gateway; Node.js CommonJS `'use strict'`, Express, `node:sqlite` `DatabaseSync`, AES-256-GCM column encryption.
- **`platform/variant.js`**: single source of truth (`VARIANTS[TRAE|WORKBUDDY|ZCODE|QODER]`); new platform = add variant entry with `capability` flags, `realms`, `hosts`, `identity`, `paths`, `errors`.
- **Capability-driven dispatch**: `can(edition,'checkin')`, `canChat`, `isEdition`, `hostFor`, `regionOf`, `clientAuthDir`, plus new `qoderRealm*` helpers.
- **ZCode precedent** (`src/zcode/`): `local.js` (credential import), `client.js` (HTTP channel + envelope unwrap), `identity.js`, `fingerprint.js`, `captcha.js`, `rewards.js` + `jobs/zcode-rewards.js` + `routes/zcode.js`. `capability.chat=false` deliberately.
- **Qoder dual-realm credential**: Chromium/Electron `os_crypt` v10 — `auth.v1.dat` = `"v10"` + nonce(12) + AES-256-GCM(ct+tag); key from sibling `Local State` → `os_crypt.encrypted_key` (base64) → strip `"DPAPI"` 5-byte prefix → DPAPI `CryptUnprotectData` → 32-byte key.
- **DPAPI from Node**: no native binding; shell out to `powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command` using `[System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData]::Unprotect`, passing base64 via **stdin** (`[Console]::In.ReadToEnd()`), never as CLI arg.
- **COSY signature (CN legacy protocol)**: `Bearer COSY.<payload_b64>.<sig>` where `sig = md5(payload\ncosyKey\ndate\nbodyEnc\npathStripped)`; 16-header set; RSA-1024 public key wraps a 16-byte tempKey used as both AES-128-CBC key and IV for the identity blob.
- **`qoder_encode`**: custom Base64 variant — standard base64 split into tail/middle/head thirds by `a = n//3`, reorder to `std[n-a:] + std[a:n-a] + std[:a]`, then translate through custom alphabet `_doRTgHZBKcGVjlvpC,@aFSx#DPuNJme&i*MzLOEn)sUrthbf%Y^w.(kIQyXqWA!` mapping `=`→`$`.
- **QMC v1 catalog**: `base64(magic "QMC\x01"(4) + nonce(12) + AES-256-GCM)`; key = `HKDF-SHA256(ikm=uid, salt="qoder-model-cache-enc", info="model-cache-v1", 32)`.
- **Store PATCH_COLUMNS**: explicit camelCase→column map in `credentials/store.js`; new columns need entries here AND in the hardcoded INSERT column list in `add()`.
- **DB migration pattern**: `ensureSchema()` uses `PRAGMA table_info` + conditional `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN`.
- **Settings store**: `createSettingsStore({name, specs})` from `lib/settings-store.js` — file > env > default, per-field clamp/coerce; `FILE()` accessor exposes the real path (project-relative `output\.trae-api\`).

## Files and Code
- **`src/platform/variant.js`** (475 lines) — Added `QODER = 'qoder'`, `QODER_REALM_CN/INTL`, and a full `VARIANTS[QODER]` entry: `realms.{cn,intl}.{openapi,gateway,docsBase,appDir,homeDir,chatProtocol}`; `capability {chat:false, checkin:false, balance:true, growth:false, billing:false, oauthLogin:false, deviceFingerprint:true, rewardClaim:true, localImport:true}`; `identity` (UA `Qoder`, clientType `10`, clientVersion `0.4.3`, cosyVersion `1.1.64`, defaultUserType `personal_profession_trial`); `paths` (userinfo/quota/campaigns/campaignClaim/cosyChat/cosyModels…); `errors`; `rewardClaimHours [10]`, `rewardClaimMinute 15`, `spreadMinutes 10`, `omitMachineHeaders true`. Added helpers: `qoderRealm`, `qoderRealmConfig`, `qoderRealmOfAccount`, `qoderOpenapiBase`, `qoderGatewayBase`; `normalizeEdition` now maps `qoder`.
- **`src/credentials/db.js`** (263) — Added `if (!names.has('qoder_realm')) db.exec("ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN qoder_realm TEXT");` and `qoderRealm: r.qoder_realm || null` in `rowToAcct`.
- **`src/credentials/store.js`** (317) — Added `qoderRealm` to `PATCH_COLUMNS`, to `acctToRow`, to `rowToDecrypted`, **and to the hardcoded INSERT column/VALUES list** in `add()` (this last one was missed initially and caused silent null readback).
- **`src/qoder/crypto.js`** (200, new) — `isWindows`, `dpapiUnprotect(buf)` (PowerShell stdin), `decryptV10(blob,key)` (v10 prefix check, nonce(12), GCM tag split, clear error messages for key mismatch), `readOsCryptKey(localStatePath)` (DPAPI prefix check), `readAuthFile(appDir)`, `normalizeAuth(data)` (field-name compat + token presence check), `readCredentials`, `candidateAppDirs(realm)`. Exports `QoderCryptoError`.
- **`src/qoder/local.js`** (162, new) — `probeRealm(realm)` (installed/clientVersion/loggedIn/credentials), `probeAll()`, `isClientInstalled()`, `appDirOf(realm)` (honors `QODER_{REALM}_APP_DIR`), `readRealmCredentials`, `buildAccountFromLocal(realm, opts)` → `{label:'qoder-<realm>-<uid>', edition:'qoder', mode:'device', qoderRealm, token, refreshToken, expiredAt, refreshExpiredAt, userId, userName, userEmail, host:openapi, source:'local'}`, `importAllLocal()` (idempotent by realm+userId).
- **`src/qoder/client.js`** (220, new) — `QoderApiError`/`QoderNetworkError`/`QoderRegionError`; `proxyDispatcher()` (reuses HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY, attaches as fetch `dispatcher`); `desktopHeaders(token, extra)` (the three load-bearing headers); `resolvePath`, `fillPath` (`%s` templates); `request(opts)` (realm→base, region-unavailable 404/405/410 handling, business-code envelope `errorCode`/`code`); `accountRequest(acct, opts)`; `baseFor`/`gatewayFor`.
- **`src/qoder/rewards.js`** (305, new) — `CLAIM_RESULT {CLAIMED,ALREADY,FAILED,SKIPPED}`; `isQoder`, `blockReason`, `campaignText` (zh→en→empty, null-safe), `parseCampaign` (full official field normalization incl. validityMode/Days), `isClaimableCredits` (CLAIM_BENEFIT + CREDITS + CLAIMABLE), `fetchCampaigns`, `fetchQuota` (two-segment `base`/`addOn`, `totalRemaining` display-only), `claimCampaign(acct, campaignId?)` (auto-picks first claimable, idempotent `replayed` → ALREADY, 409 → ALREADY), `probe`, `runForAccount(acct, {claim})` which now also emits `alreadyToday` (list-level CLAIMED credits campaigns).
- **`src/qoder/catalog.js`** (337, new) — `qoderEncode(buf)`; `SERVER_PUB_PEM` (RSA-1024, exact transcription); `deriveId(uid,salt)`; `cosyHeaders(bodyEnc, rawUrl, cred, modelKey?)` (16 headers, 9-key identity, 5-key payload, `/algo`-stripped path signature, optional `x-model-key`/`x-model-source`); `cosyGet(url, headers, body)` via `node:https` (GET+body); `fetchModelsViaCosy(acct)` with host fallback (cn → gateway; intl → api1/api2/api3.qoder.sh); `qmcDecrypt(b64Blob, uid)`; `catalogCachePath`; `normalizeModel` (preserves all official fields, adds `isFree`/`priceFactor`/`promotion`); `syncCatalog(acct, {prefer})` (cn→cosy only; intl auto→cache→cosy); `freeModels`.
- **`src/jobs/qoder-rewards.js`** (281, new) — `SPECS` (enabled/hour 10/minute 15/spreadMinutes 10/autoClaim) via `createSettingsStore`; `getEffective`, `save` (re-schedules), `qoderAccounts()` (via `store.get()` for plaintext tokens), `localClientStatus()`, `runRewards({trigger, claim, spreadMinutes})` (summary incl. `alreadyToday`/`emptyList`, `runPlanned` spread + `gapMs: 2000`, `appendTaskLog({task:'qoder-rewards'})`, four notify branches: claimed / failed / empty / already), `scheduleOnce`, `schedule`, `start`, `stop`, `restart`, `snapshot`, `FILE()`.
- **`src/routes/qoder.js`** (292, new) — `/status`, `/accounts` (GET/DELETE), `/local/preview`, `/local/import`, `/local/import/:realm`, `/accounts/:id/campaigns`, `/accounts/:id/quota`, `/accounts/:id/claim` (distinguishes `already_today` vs `no_campaign` on skip), `/run?claim=`, `/accounts/:id/models?prefer=`, `/settings` GET/POST. All behind `authenticateAdmin`; `redact()` strips token/refreshToken and adds `realm`.
- **`src/index.js`** (260) — `require('./routes/qoder')`, `app.use('/v1/qoder', qoder)` (before `/v1/admin`), `onShutdown('qoder-rewards', …stop())`, `require('./jobs/qoder-rewards').start()`; log string now includes "+ qoder rewards".
- **`src/jobs/scheduler.js`** (696) — Comment noting Qoder self-manages its own schedule and is excluded from `runDailyCheckin` because `capability.checkin=false`.
- **`src/upstream/balance.js`** (464) — Added `refreshQoderBalance(stored)`: writes `entitlementSnapshot.quota` as a **nested key** (`{base, addOn, totalRemaining, userType, usageType, isQuotaExceeded, updatedAt}`), keeps `balance: null`, `packs: []`, no `credit_history`; merges `prev` to preserve `lastClaim*`. Dispatch added in `refreshBalance` (`if (variant.isEdition(stored.edition, variant.QODER)) return refreshQoderBalance(stored)`); exported.
- **`src/models/pricing-calib.js`** (357) — `calibKey` now maps `qoder`→`qoder:` prefix (wb/trae unchanged) and is **exported** for testing.
- **`src/routes/credentials.js`** (378) — `withExpiry` now flattens `quota: snap.quota` (so the web account list can read it).
- **`src/test/qoder.test.js`** (557, new) — 50 network-free unit tests across variant/crypto/store/rewards/catalog/balance/checkin-all/pricing-calib/client. Wrapped in `async function main()` + `main().catch(...)` (project convention; top-level await breaks CJS detection).
- **`scripts/test-qoder-integration.js`** (234, new) — 28 real-upstream + real-client tests; pre-cleans leftover qoder accounts; the settings-default test backs up/restores `jobs.FILE()`.
- **`package.json`** (43) — description mentions Qoder; `test` script now includes `node src/test/qoder.test.js`; added `test:qoder`.
- **`web/src/shared/lib/format.ts`** (134) — `Platform` type gains `'qoder'`; `platformOf` returns `'qoder'` for edition `qoder`; `PLATFORM_LABEL` gains `qoder: 'Qoder'`.
- **`web/src/shared/api/types.ts`** (124) — Added `quota?: QoderQuota` on `Account` and the `QoderQuota` interface (base/addOn/totalRemaining/…).
- **`web/src/features/accounts/CredentialsPage.tsx`** (590) — Balance cell renders `a.quota.totalRemaining` with `cr` unit and a tooltip explaining two-segment isolation; check-in button hidden for `qoder` as well as `zcode`; `SourceFilter` type gains `'zcode' | 'qoder'`; filter options extended; **filter logic fixed** from the broken `sourceFilter === 'workbuddy' ? … : …` to plain `platform !== sourceFilter`.
- **`docs/qoder-integration-guide.md`** (201, new) — Full implementation/ops guide: dual-realm table, upstream chain, 6 load-bearing empirical findings, quick start, architecture, config table, metering isolation table, why forwarding is off, COSY four-error-points table, risks.
- **`docs/qoder-integration-analysis-v2.md`** (383) — Added a "✅ 已实施（2026-10-13）" banner table at top linking to the guide.
- **`docs/known-limitations.md`** (148) — Added F5 (Qoder/ZCode forwarding off), F6 (non-UTC+8 timezone alignment), F7 (Windows-only DPAPI import); test coverage updated to "10 个套件 / 407 断言".

## Errors and Fixes
- **`qoder_realm` read back as `null` after `add()`** — `acctToRow` produced the column but `add()`'s INSERT has a hardcoded column list; fixed by adding `qoder_realm` to both the column list and the `?` VALUES (35→36 placeholders).
- **`refreshQoderBalance` stored flattened snapshot** — originally `{...prev, ...quota}` put `base`/`addOn` at snapshot top level, so `routes/credentials.js`'s `snap.quota` was undefined. Fixed to `{...prev, quota}`; caught by a debug print inside the failing test, not by the assertion message.
- **`require.cache[rewardsPath]` undefined in test** — `require.resolve()` alone doesn't populate the cache. Fixed by requiring the module at test-file top so the cache entry exists before mutation.
- **`ERR_AMBIGROUS_MODULE_SYNTAX`** — top-level `await` + `require` made Node reparse the test as ESM. Fixed by wrapping in `async function main()` (matches `unit.test.js`).
- **Wrong test expectation for `qoderEncode('{}')`** — I asserted `'JTB$'`; the correct value is `'$kwm'`. Verified the implementation against an independently written reference implementation (all inputs matched) and against real upstream acceptance; the test was wrong, not the code.
- **Wrong test expectation for COSY signature determinism** — `requestId` is `crypto.randomUUID()` per call so signatures legitimately differ (replay protection). Rewrote the test to assert non-determinism + stable structure + decoded payload keys.
- **`campaignText(null)` threw** — implementation read `c.placements` unguarded. Fixed implementation (`c && Array.isArray(c.placements)`), not the test.
- **Integration test flaky `snapshot` assertion** — an earlier route test wrote `minute: 20` to `output\.trae-api\qoder-settings.json`, and my first fix deleted the wrong path (`$HOME\.trae-api\…`). tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.
